name: 21s — EZ-Bar
setupNotes: Standing, EZ-bar. Perform 7 reps bottom-half range, 7 reps top-half range, 7 reps full range — 21 total. No rest between segments.

name: 90/90 Hip Stretch
setupNotes: Sit on floor with front leg bent 90 degrees in front and back leg bent 90 degrees to the side. Lean forward over the front shin to deepen the stretch through the front hip. Hip opener — switch sides to work both hips.

name: Ab Machine Crunch
setupNotes: Seated ab crunch machine. Adjust pad at chest or behind head. Select weight. Crunch forward against resistance, controlled return.

name: Active Dead Hang
setupNotes: Pull-up bar, full hang. Engage lats and depress shoulder blades without bending elbows. Scapular activation drill.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Biceps Curl — Standing
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbell in each hand at sides. Alternating curl. Full supination at top, controlled lower. Elbows stationary.
name_es: Curl de bíceps — Mancuerna — De pie — Alterno

name: Alternating Hammer Curl — Seated
setupNotes: Seated on a bench, dumbbell in each hand at sides with neutral (palms-in) grip. Curl one arm at a time, thumbs pointing up, lowering under control before the other side curls. Targets the brachialis and brachioradialis.

name: Alternating Hammer Curl — Standing
setupNotes: Standing tall, dumbbell in each hand at sides with neutral (palms-in) grip. Curl one arm at a time, thumbs pointing up, lowering under control before the other side curls. Targets the brachialis and brachioradialis.

name: Alternating Superman
setupNotes: Lie face down, arms overhead. Lift opposite arm and leg simultaneously (right arm + left leg). Alternate sides. Controlled tempo.

name: Ankle Circles
setupNotes: Standing on one leg (hold support), rotate foot in circles. Clockwise then counterclockwise. 10 each direction. Switch feet.

name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Stretch
setupNotes: Half-kneeling facing a wall — rear knee down, front foot 4–6 inches from the wall. Drive the front knee forward toward the wall without letting the heel peel off the floor. Keep that heel planted through every rep. Mobilises the ankle into dorsiflexion — work each side.

name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Stretch — Left
setupNotes: Half-kneeling facing a wall — right knee down, left foot forward 4–6 inches from the wall. Drive the left knee forward toward the wall without lifting the left heel off the floor. Mobilises the left ankle into dorsiflexion.
name_es: Estiramiento de dorsiflexión de tobillo — Izquierda
name_fr: Étirement de cheville en dorsiflexion — Gauche
name_pt: Alongamento de tornozelo em dorsiflexão — Esquerda

name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Stretch — Right
setupNotes: Half-kneeling facing a wall — left knee down, right foot forward 4–6 inches from the wall. Drive the right knee forward toward the wall without lifting the right heel off the floor. Mobilises the right ankle into dorsiflexion.
name_es: Estiramiento de dorsiflexión de tobillo — Derecha
name_fr: Étirement de cheville en dorsiflexion — Droite
name_pt: Alongamento de tornozelo em dorsiflexão — Direita

name: Archer Pull-Up
setupNotes: Wide grip on pull-up bar. Pull toward one hand while extending the other arm straight. Alternate sides. Advanced unilateral progression.

name: Archer Push-Up
setupNotes: Hands set very wide, body in a straight line from head to heels. Lower toward one hand while the opposite arm extends out straight, then press back up through the bent arm — hips square, core braced. Alternate sides for unilateral chest and triceps work.

name: Archer Push-Up — Left
setupNotes: Very wide hand placement, body in straight line. Lower body toward the left hand while the right arm extends straight out. Press back up through the left side — unilateral chest and tricep emphasis.

name: Archer Push-Up — Right
setupNotes: Very wide hand placement, body in straight line. Lower body toward the right hand while the left arm extends straight out. Press back up through the right side — unilateral chest and tricep emphasis.

name: Arm Circles — Backward
setupNotes: Standing, arms extended straight out to sides at shoulder height. Circle arms backward, gradually increasing the size of the circles. Dynamic shoulder warm-up.

name: Arm Circles — Forward
setupNotes: Standing, arms extended straight out to sides at shoulder height. Circle arms forward, gradually increasing the size of the circles. Dynamic shoulder warm-up.

name: Weighted Arm Circles — Large Forward
setupNotes: Standing, light dumbbells (1-3 kg) in each hand, arms extended out to sides at shoulder height. Circle arms forward in large, controlled arcs. Dynamic shoulder warm-up with added load.
name_es: Círculos de brazos — Con peso — Amplios hacia delante
name_fr: Cercles de bras — Lestés — Amples vers l'avant
name_pt: Círculos de braços — Com peso — Amplos para frente

name: Arm Swings — Backward
setupNotes: Standing, swing both arms backward in large reverse arcs — pulling shoulders back and opening chest. Build momentum with each rep. Dynamic shoulder warm-up.

name: Arm Swings — Forward
setupNotes: Standing, swing both arms forward and up overhead in large arcs — then back down. Build momentum with each rep. Dynamic shoulder warm-up.

name: Arm Swings — Forward/Backward Continuous
setupNotes: Standing, swing both arms forward and up overhead in large arcs — then back down. Build momentum with each rep. Dynamic shoulder warm-up.
name_de: Armschwingen — Vor und zurück im Wechsel
name_es: Balanceos de brazos — Delante y atrás continuo
name_fr: Balancements de bras — Avant-arrière en continu
name_pt: Balanços de braços — Frente e trás contínuo

name: Arm Swings — Lateral
setupNotes: Standing tall, arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height. Swing both arms horizontally — open wide, then cross them in front of the chest and back open again, staying in the horizontal plane throughout. Dynamic warm-up for the chest, shoulders and upper back.

name: Arnold Press
setupNotes: Seated on upright bench with back support. Start with dumbbells at chin, palms facing you. Rotate palms outward as you press overhead.

name: Arnold Press — Standing
setupNotes: Standing tall, dumbbells at chin with palms facing you, elbows tight. Rotate palms outward as you press overhead — finish with arms locked, palms forward. Brace the core to prevent lower-back arching. Targets all three deltoid heads with extra core demand vs. seated.

name: Assault / Air Bike — Intervals
setupNotes: Air bike / assault bike. Arms and legs drive together. Sprint intervals (20-30 sec on, 60-90 sec off). Total body cardio.

name: Assisted Parallel Dip
setupNotes: Assisted dip/pull-up machine. Kneel or stand on pad, select counterweight. Upright torso for triceps focus. Full range of motion.

name: B-Stance Romanian Deadlift
setupNotes: Standing with one foot half a step behind (heel up). Most weight on front leg. Hinge at hips with dumbbells. Unilateral emphasis with bilateral stability.

name: Back Extension — Banded
setupNotes: Hyper-extension / back-extension bench. Pad at hip crease, feet anchored. Loop a resistance band around the upper back and under the foot platform — band adds tension at the top of the rep. Hinge at the hips down and up, hands behind head or crossed on chest.

name: Back Extension — Standard (Machine)
setupNotes: Hyper extension / back extension bench. Pad at hip crease, feet anchored. Hinge at hips down and up. Hands behind head or crossed on chest.

name: Back Extension — Standard (Machine) — Banded
setupNotes: Standard back-extension machine, pad against the upper back, feet anchored on the foot plate. Loop a resistance band around the chest pad and the base of the machine for added top-end tension. Extend the torso back against the pad — hinge through the hips, not the lower back. Trains spinal erectors and glutes.
name_es: Hiperextensión lumbar — Máquina — Con banda — Estándar
name_fr: Extension du dos — Machine — Standard — Élastique
name_pt: Extensão lombar — Máquina com elástico — Padrão

name: Back Extension — Weighted
setupNotes: Same setup as standard. Hold weight plate or dumbbell against chest for added resistance. Controlled tempo.

name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
setupNotes: Loop resistance band over pull-up bar, step one or both feet into band. Perform pull-up with band support reducing bodyweight load.

name: Band Pull-Apart
setupNotes: Hold resistance band at chest height with straight arms, shoulder-width grip. Pull band apart by squeezing shoulder blades together. Controlled return.

name: Band Pull-Apart — 3 Position
setupNotes: Perform band pull-aparts at three heights: overhead, eye level, and chest level. Hits rear delts and rhomboids from different angles.

name: Band T-Raise
setupNotes: Stand on or anchor band low. Arms straight, raise to sides forming a T (arms horizontal). Lower controlled. Middle trap and rear delt.

name: Band W-Raise
setupNotes: Stand on or anchor band low. Pull into W-shape — elbows bent, upper arms at 45 degrees, hands at ear level. Squeeze shoulder blades. Rotator cuff.

name: Band Y-Raise
setupNotes: Stand on or anchor band low. Arms straight, raise into Y-shape overhead (arms at ~45 degrees from body). Lower controlled. Lower trap activation.

name: Banded Hip Thrust
setupNotes: Upper back on bench, resistance band across hips anchored by feet or heavy dumbbells. Drive hips up to full extension. Band adds tension at top.

name: Banded Hip Thrust — Standing
setupNotes: Standing tall, resistance band looped around the hips and anchored at low height behind you (rack post or band peg). Push the hips forward against band tension into a tall lockout, then return to a slight hinge. Squeeze glutes hard at the top — keep ribs down. A standing alternative to the floor hip thrust.
name_es: Hip thrust — Con banda — De pie
name_pt: Elevação pélvica — Com elástico — Em pé

name: Banded Shoulder Distraction
setupNotes: Heavy band anchored to a rack at shoulder height. Loop it around the working wrist and step away to build tension, then drop into a lunge or hinge so the band gently distracts the shoulder. Breathe and let the joint settle rather than forcing it — mobilises the shoulder capsule. Switch sides.

name: Banded Shoulder Distraction — Left
setupNotes: Anchor a heavy band to a rack at shoulder height. Loop the band around the left wrist and step away to create tension, then drop into a lunge or hinge so the band gently distracts the left shoulder. Hold and breathe. Mobilises the left shoulder capsule.
name_es: Distracción de hombro — Con banda — Izquierda
name_pt: Distração de ombro — Com elástico — Esquerda

name: Banded Shoulder Distraction — Right
setupNotes: Anchor a heavy band to a rack at shoulder height. Loop the band around the right wrist and step away to create tension, then drop into a lunge or hinge so the band gently distracts the right shoulder. Hold and breathe. Mobilises the right shoulder capsule.
name_es: Distracción de hombro — Con banda — Derecha
name_pt: Distração de ombro — Com elástico — Direita

name: Barbell Back Squat — Paused
setupNotes: Power rack, bar on upper traps (high bar) or rear delts (low bar). Feet shoulder-width apart. Descend under control until thighs are at or below parallel and hold a deliberate 2–3 second pause at the bottom — no bouncing out of the hole. Drive up through the heels. Builds bottom-position strength and control.

name: Barbell Back Squat — Standard
setupNotes: Power rack, bar on upper traps (high bar) or rear delts (low bar). Feet shoulder-width apart. Descend until thighs parallel or below — drive up through heels.

name: Barbell Back Squat — Wide Stance
setupNotes: Power rack, bar on upper traps (high bar) or rear delts (low bar). Wide stance, toes angled out. Descend until thighs parallel or below — drive up through heels.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row — Overhand
setupNotes: Standing, hinge at hips ~45 degrees. Barbell hanging at arm's length, overhand grip. Row bar to lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades.
name_fr: Rowing buste penché — Barre — Prise pronation

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row — Underhand
setupNotes: Same hinge position as overhand row. Underhand (supinated) grip at shoulder-width. Row to lower stomach, elbows close to body.
name_fr: Rowing buste penché — Barre — Prise supination

name: Barbell Curl — Standing
setupNotes: Standing, barbell with shoulder-width grip. Elbows pinned to sides. Curl to shoulder height, controlled lower. Avoid swinging torso.
name_es: Curl de bíceps — Barra — De pie

name: Barbell Floor Press
setupNotes: Lie on floor with barbell. Knees bent, feet flat. Upper arms touch floor at bottom of each rep.

name: Barbell Floor Press — Close-Narrow Grip
setupNotes: Lie on floor with barbell. Knees bent, feet flat. Hands narrower than shoulders for triceps emphasis. Lower bar to chest, upper arms touch floor at bottom — press up explosively.
name_pt: Supino no chão — Barra — Pegada fechada

name: Barbell Front Squat
setupNotes: Power rack, bar across front delts in front rack (clean grip) or cross-arm position. Elbows high. Descend to parallel or below, upright torso.

name: Barbell Good Morning
setupNotes: Barbell on upper back (like a squat). Feet hip-width apart. Hinge at hips, push hips back, lower torso to roughly parallel — stand up by driving hips forward.

name: Barbell Good Morning — Seated
setupNotes: Seated on a flat bench, barbell across upper back as for a squat. Feet planted. Hinge forward at hips, chest down toward thighs. Drive hips and torso back up — isolates the lower back without leg involvement.

name: Barbell Hang Snatch
setupNotes: Barbell at hip level, wide snatch grip. Dip-drive hips, pull bar overhead, catch with straight arms. Start from hang position, not floor.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
setupNotes: Upper back on bench, barbell across hip crease (pad the bar). Feet flat on floor, hip-width. Drive hips up to full extension, squeeze glutes. Lower controlled.

name: Barbell Shrug
setupNotes: Standing, barbell held at hip level with overhand grip, shoulder-width. Shrug shoulders straight up toward ears. Brief hold at top, controlled lower.

name: Barbell Skull Crusher
setupNotes: Flat bench, barbell or EZ-bar. Arms extended over face/forehead. Lower bar by bending elbows to forehead level, extend back up. Spotter recommended.

name: Barbell Snatch
setupNotes: Barbell on floor, very wide grip. Explosive pull from floor, pull body under bar, catch overhead with straight arms in squat. Stand up. Technical lift.

name: Barbell Thruster
setupNotes: Barbell in front rack position on shoulders, feet shoulder-width. Squat to full depth, then drive up explosively and press the bar to overhead lockout in one fluid motion. Full-body power — legs, shoulders and core.

name: Barbell Upright Row
setupNotes: Standing, grip barbell at hip width. Pull straight up along body to chin level, elbows high.

name: Barbell Wrist Curl
setupNotes: Seated, forearms resting on thighs or preacher bench, palms up. Barbell in hands. Curl wrists upward, controlled lower. Let bar roll to fingers for extra range.

name: Battle Ropes — Alternating Waves
setupNotes: Stand with knees slightly bent, one rope end in each hand. Alternate arms creating continuous waves in rope. Full body cardio.

name: Battle Ropes — Kneeling Power Slam
setupNotes: Kneel on mat, both rope ends in hands. Raise both arms overhead then slam ropes down together. Removes legs, isolates upper body and core power.
name_es: Cuerdas de batalla — Arrodillado — Slam de fuerza
name_fr: Battle ropes — Slam de force — À genoux
name_pt: Corda naval — Ajoelhado — Slam de potência

name: Battle Ropes — Kneeling Waves
setupNotes: Kneel on mat, one rope end in each hand. Alternating waves from kneeling position. Removes legs, isolates upper body and core.

name: Battle Ropes — Power Slam
setupNotes: Stand with knees slightly bent, both rope ends. Raise both arms overhead then slam ropes down together. Squat with slam. Full body power.
name_es: Cuerdas de batalla — Slam de fuerza

name: Bear Crawl
setupNotes: On hands and feet (not knees), knees hovering just off ground. Crawl forward moving opposite hand and foot together. Core and full body.

name: Behind-the-Back Barbell Wrist Curl
setupNotes: Standing, barbell held behind body at arms length, palms facing back. Curl wrists up, controlled lower. Standing allows heavier loads.
name_es: Curl de muñeca detrás de la espalda — Barra
name_fr: Curl de poignet derrière le dos — Barre
name_pt: Rosca de punho — Barra — Atrás do corpo

name: Behind-the-Back Cable Curl
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, D-handle. Stand facing away from machine, arm extended behind. Curl forward against cable for unique stretch-focused angle.
name_es: Curl de bíceps detrás de la espalda — Polea
name_pt: Rosca direta — Polia — Atrás do corpo

name: Behind-the-Back Cable Lateral Raise
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, D-handle passed behind back. Stand sideways. Raise arm to side — cable behind body keeps tension through full range.
name_es: Elevación lateral detrás de la espalda — Polea
name_fr: Élévation latérale derrière le dos — Poulie
name_pt: Elevação lateral — Polia — Atrás do corpo

name: Belt Squat
setupNotes: Belt squat machine. Attach belt around hips to weight, stand on elevated platforms. Squat down and up — zero spinal loading. Quad and glute focus.

name: Bench Dip — Standard
setupNotes: Hands on edge of bench behind body, fingers forward. Feet on floor, legs extended or bent. Lower body by bending elbows, press back up.

name: Bench Dip — Weighted
setupNotes: Same as standard bench dip. Place weight plate on lap for additional resistance. Spotter may assist with plate placement.

name: Bench Press — Smith Machine
setupNotes: Smith machine bar set at chest level over a flat bench. Lie supine, feet flat, shoulder blades retracted. Unrack with a small wrist twist, lower bar to mid-chest, press to lockout. Fixed bar path keeps form locked in.

name: Bench-Supported One-Arm Row
setupNotes: Incline bench at ~30 degrees, chest against pad. Dumbbell in one side hand — row to one side hip, elbow tracking close to body. Bench prevents momentum for strict lat work.
name_es: Remo a un brazo apoyado en banco
name_fr: Rowing à un bras — Appui sur banc

name: Bench-Supported One-Arm Row — Left Arm
setupNotes: Incline bench at ~30 degrees, chest against pad. Dumbbell in left hand — row to left hip, elbow tracking close to body. Bench prevents momentum for strict lat work.
name_es: Remo a un brazo apoyado en banco — Brazo izquierdo
name_fr: Rowing à un bras — Appui sur banc — Bras gauche
name_pt: Remada unilateral apoiada no banco — Braço esquerdo

name: Bench-Supported One-Arm Row — Right Arm
setupNotes: Incline bench at ~30 degrees, chest against pad. Dumbbell in right hand — row to right hip, elbow tracking close to body. Bench prevents momentum for strict lat work.
name_es: Remo a un brazo apoyado en banco — Brazo derecho
name_fr: Rowing à un bras — Appui sur banc — Bras droit
name_pt: Remada unilateral apoiada no banco — Braço direito

name: Bicycle Crunch — Slow Tempo
setupNotes: Lie face up, hands behind head, shoulders lifted. Slowly twist one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg — 3–4 seconds per side. Full rotation through the torso — maximises oblique time under tension.

name: Bicycle Crunch — Standard
setupNotes: Lie face up, hands behind head (don't pull neck). Lift shoulders, twist right elbow to left knee while extending right leg. Alternate continuously.

name: Bird Dog — Band-Resisted
setupNotes: Kneeling bird-dog stance on hands and knees, a light band running from one hand to the opposite foot. Extend that arm and leg until the band is taut, hold, then return under control. Keep the hips square to the floor. Adds resistance and instability to the diagonal pattern — alternate sides.

name: Bird Dog — Band-Resisted — Left
setupNotes: Kneeling bird-dog stance with a light resistance band running from the left hand to the right foot. Extend the left arm and right leg until the band is taut, hold, return. Band adds resistance and instability to the diagonal pattern.

name: Bird Dog — Band-Resisted — Right
setupNotes: Kneeling bird-dog stance with a light resistance band running from the right hand to the left foot. Extend the right arm and left leg until the band is taut, hold, return. Band adds resistance and instability to the diagonal pattern.

name: Bird Dog — From Push-Up Position
setupNotes: High plank position, hands under shoulders, body in a line from head to heels. Extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back at the same time, hold briefly, then return and alternate sides. Keep the hips square to the floor — no rotation. Much harder than the kneeling version.
name_es: Bird dog — Desde posición de flexión
name_fr: Bird dog — Depuis la position de pompe
name_pt: Bird dog — Da posição de flexão

name: Bird Dog — From Push-Up Position — Left
setupNotes: High plank position, hands under shoulders, body in a straight line. Extend the left arm forward and the right leg back simultaneously, hold briefly without letting the hips rotate. Return. Much harder than the kneeling version.
name_de: Bird Dog — Aus der Liegestützposition — Links
name_es: Bird dog — Desde posición de flexión — Izquierda
name_fr: Bird dog — Depuis la position de pompe — Gauche
name_pt: Bird dog — Da posição de flexão — Esquerda

name: Bird Dog — From Push-Up Position — Right
setupNotes: High plank position, hands under shoulders, body in a straight line. Extend the right arm forward and the left leg back simultaneously, hold briefly without letting the hips rotate. Return. Much harder than the kneeling version.
name_de: Bird Dog — Aus der Liegestützposition — Rechts
name_es: Bird dog — Desde posición de flexión — Derecha
name_fr: Bird dog — Depuis la position de pompe — Droite
name_pt: Bird dog — Da posição de flexão — Direita

name: Bird Dog Hold
setupNotes: On hands and knees, spine neutral. Extend the left arm forward and the right leg back simultaneously until both are parallel to the floor. Brace the core, hold briefly, return. Trains anti-extension and balance.

name: Bird Dog Row (Weighted)
setupNotes: Quadruped bird-dog position, dumbbell in one hand. Extend the opposite leg back, then row the dumbbell to the hip and lower under control — hips stay square, no rotation toward the working arm. Combines anti-rotation core work with a unilateral row, each side.
name_es: Bird dog con remo — Con peso
name_pt: Bird dog com remada — Com peso

name: Bird Dog Row (Weighted) — Left Arm
setupNotes: Kneeling bird-dog stance with a dumbbell in the left hand. Extend the right leg back, then row the left dumbbell to the hip — keeping the hips square and core braced. Lower the dumbbell, return. Combines anti-rotation with a unilateral row.
name_es: Bird dog con remo — Con peso — Brazo izquierdo
name_fr: Bird dog avec rowing — Lesté — Bras gauche
name_pt: Bird dog com remada — Com peso — Braço esquerdo

name: Bird Dog Row (Weighted) — Right Arm
setupNotes: Kneeling bird-dog stance with a dumbbell in the right hand. Extend the left leg back, then row the right dumbbell to the hip — keeping the hips square and core braced. Lower the dumbbell, return. Combines anti-rotation with a unilateral row.
name_es: Bird dog con remo — Con peso — Brazo derecho
name_fr: Bird dog avec rowing — Lesté — Bras droit
name_pt: Bird dog com remada — Com peso — Braço direito

name: Bird Dog — Standard
setupNotes: On hands and knees, spine neutral, wrists under shoulders. Extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back at the same time until both reach parallel with the floor. Brace the core so the hips stay level and never rotate, hold briefly, then return. Trains anti-extension and balance — alternate sides.

name: Bird Dog — Standard — Left
setupNotes: On hands and knees, spine neutral. Extend the left arm forward and the right leg back simultaneously until both are parallel to the floor. Brace the core, hold briefly, return. Trains anti-extension and balance.

name: Bird Dog — Standard — Right
setupNotes: On hands and knees, spine neutral. Extend the right arm forward and the left leg back simultaneously until both are parallel to the floor. Brace the core, hold briefly, return. Trains anti-extension and balance.

name: Bodyweight Calf Raise on Step
setupNotes: Standing on edge of step or platform (no additional weight). Rise onto toes, controlled lower below platform level for full stretch. Both feet.
name_es: Elevación de gemelos en escalón — Peso corporal
name_fr: Mollets — Poids du corps — Sur step
name_pt: Elevação de panturrilha — Peso corporal — No degrau

name: Bodyweight Lateral Lunge
setupNotes: Standing, step wide to one side, bend stepping leg, keep other leg straight. Push off to return. Using bodyweight.

name: Bodyweight Squat
setupNotes: Standing, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out. Arms forward for balance. Squat down to parallel or below. Drive up through heels.

name: Bodyweight Step-Up
setupNotes: Sturdy chair, bench, or staircase step. Place one foot fully on surface. Drive through one side heel to stand tall on top. Step down controlled. All reps on one leg.

name: Bodyweight Step-Up — Left Leg
setupNotes: Sturdy chair, bench, or staircase step. Place left foot fully on surface. Drive through left heel to stand tall on top. Step down controlled. All reps on left leg.
name_es: Subida al cajón — Peso corporal — Pierna izquierda
name_fr: Step-up — Poids du corps — Jambe gauche
name_pt: Subida no banco — Peso corporal — Perna esquerda

name: Bodyweight Step-Up — Right Leg
setupNotes: Sturdy chair, bench, or staircase step. Place right foot fully on surface. Drive through right heel to stand tall on top. Step down controlled. All reps on right leg.
name_es: Subida al cajón — Peso corporal — Pierna derecha
name_fr: Step-up — Poids du corps — Jambe droite
name_pt: Subida no banco — Peso corporal — Perna direita

name: Box Jump Squat
setupNotes: Stand facing sturdy plyo box or platform. Squat, swing arms, jump onto box landing softly in squat. Step down. Adjust box height to ability.

name: Box Squat — Barbell
setupNotes: Power rack with box or bench behind you at parallel-depth. Bar on back. Sit back to box, brief pause, drive up explosively. Controlled descent.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Back Rack
setupNotes: Rear foot elevated on a bench, barbell racked across the upper back. Lower into a split squat until the front thigh reaches parallel, then drive through the front heel to stand. Keep the torso tall and the front knee tracking over the toes. Trains quads and glutes one leg at a time under spinal load.
name_fr: Squat bulgare — Barre — Sur le dos
name_pt: Agachamento búlgaro — Barra — Carga nas costas

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Back Rack — Left Leg
setupNotes: Right foot rear-elevated on a bench, barbell racked across the upper back. Lower into a split squat until the left front thigh is parallel, then drive through the left heel to stand. Trains the left quad and glute under spinal load.
name_de: Bulgarische Kniebeuge — Langhantel — Back Rack — Linkes Bein
name_es: Sentadilla búlgara — Barra — Rack trasero — Pierna izquierda
name_fr: Squat bulgare — Barre — Sur le dos — Jambe gauche

setupNotes: Barbell racked across the upper back, rear foot elevated on a bench behind you and the working foot planted ahead. Lower into a split squat until the front thigh is parallel, then hold a deliberate 1-2 second pause at the bottom to kill the stretch reflex before driving up through the front heel. name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Back Rack — Paused — Left Leg
setupNotes: Right foot rear-elevated on a bench, left foot forward, barbell racked across the upper back. Lower until the left front thigh is parallel, hold a deliberate 1-2 second pause at the bottom to kill the stretch reflex, then drive through the left heel to stand. The paused tempo builds bottom-position strength in the left quad and glute under spinal load.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Back Rack — Paused — Right Leg
setupNotes: Left foot rear-elevated on a bench, right foot forward, barbell racked across the upper back. Lower until the right front thigh is parallel, hold a deliberate 1-2 second pause at the bottom to kill the stretch reflex, then drive through the right heel to stand. The paused tempo builds bottom-position strength in the right quad and glute under spinal load.

name_pt: Agachamento búlgaro — Barra — Carga nas costas — Com pausa — Perna direita

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Dumbbell — Right Leg

setupNotes: Standing, jog in place kicking heels up to touch glutes. Pump arms naturally. Light bounce on balls of feet. Hamstring warm-up and cardio.

name: Cable Chest Press — Low

name: Cable Chest Press — Mid
setupNotes: Dual cable station, pulleys set at mid (chest) position with D-handles. Stand facing away in a split stance, handles at chest level. Press both handles forward to full extension, meeting at midline — targets the mid-chest with constant cable tension.

name: Cable Russian Twist — Right

setupNotes: Pull-up bar, underhand (supinated) grip at shoulder-width. Pull chin over bar, squeezing biceps and lats. Full hang at bottom.

name: Clamshell — Banded
setupNotes: Lie on one side with a mini band looped just above the knees, knees bent to 90 degrees and feet stacked. Open the top knee against the band, squeezing the glute medius, then lower under control. Keep the hips stacked — no rolling backward. Targets the glute medius, each side.

name: Clamshell — Banded — Left
setupNotes: Lie on the right side with a mini band looped just above the knees, knees bent to 90 degrees and feet stacked. Open the left (top) knee against the band's resistance, squeezing the left glute medius. Lower under control.

name: Clamshell — Banded — Right
setupNotes: Lie on the left side with a mini band looped just above the knees, knees bent to 90 degrees and feet stacked. Open the right (top) knee against the band's resistance, squeezing the right glute medius. Lower under control.

name: Clamshell — Standard
setupNotes: Lie on one side with the knees bent to 90 degrees, feet and hips stacked. Keep the feet touching and open the top knee upward like a clamshell, then lower under control — do not let the hips roll backward. Targets the glute medius, each side.

name: Clamshell — Standard — Left
setupNotes: Lie on the right side, knees bent to 90 degrees, feet stacked together. Keep the feet touching and open the left (top) knee upward like a clamshell, squeezing the left glute medius. Lower under control.

name: Clamshell — Standard — Right
setupNotes: Lie on the left side, knees bent to 90 degrees, feet stacked together. Keep the feet touching and open the right (top) knee upward like a clamshell, squeezing the right glute medius. Lower under control.

name: Clap Push-Up
setupNotes: Standard push-up position on firm floor. Push explosively so hands leave ground, clap, land softly with bent elbows. Plyometric power.

name: Clean and Press
setupNotes: Perform a power clean from floor to front rack, then press (or push press) overhead to lockout. Lower bar and repeat. Full body compound.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press — Barbell

name: Close-Grip Bench Press — Dumbbell (Neutral)

setupNotes: Decline bench, feet secured. Press dumbbells with a neutral (palms-facing) grip and dumbbells touching above lower chest. setupNotes: Incline bench (30-45 degrees). Press dumbbells with a neutral (palms-facing) grip and dumbbells touching above the upper chest. Lower under control until upper arms touch ribs, press back up keeping dumbbells together. Neutral close grip is shoulder-friendly and emphasises upper chest and triceps.
