name: Close-Grip Pull-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar, overhand grip with hands touching or 6 inches apart. Pull chin over bar. More bicep and lower lat involvement.

name: Commando Pull-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar, hands staggered one in front of the other (perpendicular grip). Pull head to one side of bar, alternate sides.

name: Concentration Curl — Seated
setupNotes: Seated on bench, one side elbow braced against inner one side thigh. Dumbbell in one side hand hanging toward the floor — curl up in strict isolation, squeezing the biceps at the top. No torso movement.

name: Concentration Curl — Seated — Left Arm
setupNotes: Seated on bench, left elbow braced against inner left thigh. Dumbbell in left hand hanging toward the floor — curl up in strict isolation, squeezing the biceps at the top. No torso movement.

name: Concentration Curl — Seated — Right Arm
setupNotes: Seated on bench, right elbow braced against inner right thigh. Dumbbell in right hand hanging toward the floor — curl up in strict isolation, squeezing the biceps at the top. No torso movement.

name: Conventional Barbell Deadlift
setupNotes: Barbell on floor, feet hip-width (conventional stance). Mixed or double-overhand grip just outside knees. Flat back, chest up — drive through heels to lockout.

name: Couch Stretch
setupNotes: Kneel facing away from a wall with the rear shin pressed up against it, toes pointing up, and the front foot planted forward in a lunge. Tuck the pelvis under and push the hips forward while staying tall. Keep the ribs down so the lower back doesn't arch — an intense quad and hip flexor stretch. Switch sides.

name: Couch Stretch — Left
setupNotes: Kneel facing away from a wall with the left shin pressed up against it (toes pointing up), right foot forward in a lunge. Tuck the pelvis and push the hips forward, staying tall. Intense stretch of the left quad and hip flexor.

name: Couch Stretch — Right
setupNotes: Kneel facing away from a wall with the right shin pressed up against it (toes pointing up), left foot forward in a lunge. Tuck the pelvis and push the hips forward, staying tall. Intense stretch of the right quad and hip flexor.

name: Cross-Body Arm Swings
setupNotes: Standing, swing both arms horizontally across body in alternating cross pattern. Opens chest and warms up shoulders and pecs.

name: Cross-Body Biceps Curl
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbell in each hand. Curl one dumbbell across the body toward the opposite shoulder with supinated grip — palm up at top. Targets the long head of the biceps. Alternate arms.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
setupNotes: Standing, curl dumbbell across body toward opposite shoulder with neutral grip. Targets brachialis and brachioradialis. Alternate arms.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl — Seated
setupNotes: Seated on a bench, dumbbell in each hand. Curl one dumbbell across the body toward the opposite shoulder with neutral grip. Targets brachialis and brachioradialis. Alternate arms.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
setupNotes: Stand tall and bring one arm straight across the chest. Hook the opposite forearm under that elbow and draw the arm closer to the body. Keep the shoulder pulled down rather than shrugged toward the ear. Hold, then switch sides — stretches the rear delt and upper back.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch — Left
setupNotes: Standing tall, bring the left arm straight across the chest. Hook the right forearm under the left elbow and pull the left arm closer to the body. Hold. Stretches the left rear delt and upper back.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch — Right
setupNotes: Standing tall, bring the right arm straight across the chest. Hook the left forearm under the right elbow and pull the right arm closer to the body. Hold. Stretches the right rear delt and upper back.

name: Cuban Rotation — Disk — Front
setupNotes: Standing, weight plate held at hip in one hand. Pull elbow up so upper arm is parallel to floor and elbow is bent 90 degrees — forearm hanging down. Rotate forearm up until it points to the ceiling, controlled lower. Light load — pure rotator cuff work.

name: Cuban Rotation — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Standing, elbows at 90 degrees at shoulder height. Rotate forearms from pointing down to pointing up. Prehab / rotator cuff work.

name: Curtsy Lunge — Bodyweight
setupNotes: Stand tall, hands at the chest. Step one foot back and across behind the other leg, lowering until the front thigh is parallel to the floor. Drive through the front heel to return to standing, then alternate sides. Keep the hips facing forward — targets the glute medius.

name: Curtsy Lunge — Bodyweight — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall. Step the left foot behind and across the right leg, lowering until the right thigh is parallel to the floor. Drive through the right heel to return to standing. Targets the glute medius.
name_es: Zancada cruzada — Peso corporal — Pierna izquierda
name_fr: Fente croisée — Poids du corps — Jambe gauche
name_pt: Recuo cruzado — Peso corporal — Perna esquerda

name: Curtsy Lunge — Bodyweight — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall. Step the right foot behind and across the left leg, lowering until the left thigh is parallel to the floor. Drive through the left heel to return to standing. Targets the glute medius.
name_es: Zancada cruzada — Peso corporal — Pierna derecha
name_fr: Fente croisée — Poids du corps — Jambe droite
name_pt: Recuo cruzado — Peso corporal — Perna direita

name: Dead Bug — Banded
setupNotes: Standard dead bug position. Light resistance band looped around hands and/or feet. Band tension adds core demand through full range.

name: Dead Bug — Slow Tempo
setupNotes: Same position as standard dead bug. Very slow controlled extension (4-5 seconds out, 4-5 seconds back). Focus on maintaining lower back contact with floor.

name: Dead Bug — Standard
setupNotes: Lie face up, arms straight toward ceiling, knees bent 90 degrees (tabletop). Extend opposite arm/leg toward floor, return, alternate. Press lower back into floor.

name: Dead Bug — Weighted
setupNotes: Standard dead bug position holding light dumbbell in hands overhead. Extend limbs with control. Added load on core stabilisers.

name: Dead Bug with Physio Ball
setupNotes: Lie face up, squeeze physio ball between hands and knees. Extend opposite arm and leg while maintaining ball pressure with other limbs.

name: Dead Hang
setupNotes: Pull-up bar at height allowing full hang without feet touching floor. Overhand grip, relax shoulders, decompress spine. Timed hold.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
setupNotes: Decline bench inside power rack, feet secured. Bar at chest height, spotter recommended. Shoulder blades retracted. Unrack, lower bar to lower chest — press up to lockout.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press — Narrow-Close Grip
setupNotes: Decline bench inside power rack, feet secured. Hands narrower than shoulders on the bar. Unrack, lower bar to lower chest with elbows tucked, press up to lockout — emphasises triceps and lower-chest insertion.
name_es: Press de banca declinado — Barra — Agarre cerrado

name: Decline Crunch
setupNotes: Decline bench, feet hooked under pads. Lie back, hands behind head or across chest. Crunch up, lifting shoulder blades off bench. Controlled lower.

name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
setupNotes: Decline bench with dumbbell rack nearby. Start with dumbbells on thighs, kick up to pressing position. Retract shoulder blades.

name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press — Close Grip Neutral
setupNotes: Decline bench, dumbbells held with neutral grip (palms facing each other) above lower chest. Lower under control until upper arms touch ribs, press back up keeping dumbbells close together. Neutral grip is shoulder-friendly and shifts emphasis to lower chest and triceps.
name_es: Press de banca declinado — Mancuerna — Agarre cerrado neutro
name_fr: Développé décliné — Haltère — Prise serrée neutre
name_pt: Supino declinado — Halter — Pegada neutra fechada

name: Decline Dumbbell Chest Fly
setupNotes: Decline bench with moderate dumbbells. Arms extended above chest, slight elbow bend. Lower in arc until stretch is felt.

name: Decline Machine Chest Press — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Decline chest press machine — adjust seat so handles align with lower chest. Grip overhand with palms down, back against pad, feet flat. Press handles forward and slightly down — targets lower chest fibres.
name_es: Press de pecho declinado — Máquina — Agarre prono

name: Decline Push-Up
setupNotes: Feet elevated on bench, box, or chair. Hands on floor shoulder-width. Body in straight line from feet to head. Lower chest to floor, press up.

name: Decline Reverse Crunch
setupNotes: Decline bench, grip bench above head. Bring knees toward chest by lifting hips off bench. Controlled lower. Lower ab emphasis.

name: Decline Slow Tempo Push-Up
setupNotes: Feet elevated on bench or box, hands on floor shoulder-width, body in straight line. Lower chest toward floor for 3–4 seconds, pause 1 second at bottom, press up with control. Tempo work emphasises upper chest and shoulders.

name: Decline Twisting Crunch
setupNotes: Same decline bench setup. Crunch up with rotation — right elbow toward left knee, alternate. Engages obliques with rectus abdominis.

name: Decline Twisting Crunch — Weighted
setupNotes: Same decline bench setup, holding a plate or dumbbell at the chest. Crunch up with rotation — right elbow toward left knee, alternate. Added load amplifies oblique engagement.
name_es: Crunch declinado con giro — Con peso
name_pt: Abdominal declinado com rotação — Com peso

name: Diamond Push-Up
setupNotes: Hands on floor with index fingers and thumbs touching (diamond shape). Body in straight line. Lower chest to hands, press up. Triceps-dominant.

name: Diaphragmatic Breathing — Supine
setupNotes: Lie face up, knees bent, feet flat. One hand on chest, one on belly. Breathe deeply into belly (belly rises), chest stays still. Slow exhale.

name: Donkey Kick
setupNotes: Quadruped on a mat, hands under the shoulders and knees under the hips. Drive the working heel toward the ceiling with the knee bent 90 degrees and squeeze the glute at the top, then lower under control — lower back flat, no arching. Isolates the glutes, each side.

name: Donkey Kick — Left
setupNotes: On hands and knees in quadruped, mat under knees. Drive left heel toward the ceiling with knee bent 90 degrees, squeezing the glute at top. Controlled return — isolates the left glute.
name_pt: Coice de glúteo — Quatro apoios — Esquerda

name: Donkey Kick — Right
setupNotes: On hands and knees in quadruped, mat under knees. Drive right heel toward the ceiling with knee bent 90 degrees, squeezing the glute at top. Controlled return — isolates the right glute.
name_pt: Coice de glúteo — Quatro apoios — Direita

name: Double-Arm Landmine Chest Press
setupNotes: Barbell loaded into a landmine attachment or wedged in a corner. Stand in a staggered stance, both hands cupped around the end of the bar held at the chest. Press the bar forward and up in a roughly horizontal arc to full extension, then lower under control — drives the chest (pecs) with front-delt and triceps assistance.
name_es: Press de pecho landmine a dos brazos
name_fr: Développé poitrine landmine à deux bras

name: Double-Arm Landmine Shoulder Press
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment, staggered stance. Grip end of bar at chest with both hands. Press upward in an arc until arms are extended — lower slowly.
name_es: Press de hombros landmine a dos brazos
name_fr: Développé épaules landmine à deux bras

name: Drag Curl — Barbell
setupNotes: Standing, barbell at hip level. Instead of curling in arc, drag bar up body by pulling elbows straight back. Bar stays in contact with torso.

name: Dragon Flag
setupNotes: Lie on flat bench, grip bench behind head. Lift entire body off bench in straight line, lower under control without touching bench. Advanced core.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
setupNotes: Lie on floor with dumbbell. Knees bent, feet flat. Upper arms touch floor at bottom of each rep.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press — Close Grip Neutral
setupNotes: Lie on floor, knees bent, dumbbells with neutral grip (palms facing each other) over chest. Lower until upper arms touch the floor, press back up keeping dumbbells close. Floor stops range of motion — easy on shoulders, heavy emphasis on triceps and lockout.
name_es: Floor press — Mancuerna — Agarre cerrado neutro
name_fr: Floor press — Haltère — Prise serrée neutre
name_pt: Supino no chão — Halter — Pegada neutra fechada

name: Dumbbell Good Morning
setupNotes: Hold dumbbells at shoulders or behind head. Feet hip-width apart. Hinge at hips, push hips back, lower torso to roughly parallel — stand up by driving hips forward.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
setupNotes: Standing, step wide to one side, bend stepping leg, keep other leg straight. Push off to return. Using dumbbell.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge — Left Side
setupNotes: Standing tall with a dumbbell in each hand. Step wide to the left side, push hips back and bend the left knee — right leg stays straight, both feet flat. Push off the left foot to return. Trains adductors, glutes and hip mobility.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge — Right Side
setupNotes: Standing tall with a dumbbell in each hand. Step wide to the right side, push hips back and bend the right knee — left leg stays straight, both feet flat. Push off the right foot to return. Trains adductors, glutes and hip mobility.

name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
setupNotes: Preacher curl bench, dumbbell in one hand. Upper arm flat on pad. Curl up, squeeze at top, slow eccentric. Full stretch at bottom.

name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl — Alternating
setupNotes: Preacher curl bench, dumbbell in each hand. Both upper arms flat on pad. Curl one arm at a time, squeeze at top, slow eccentric before the other side curls. Full stretch at bottom.
name_es: Curl en banco Scott — Mancuerna — Alterno

name: Dumbbell Row — Standard
setupNotes: Standing, hinge at hips with flat back to roughly 45 degrees, dumbbell in each hand hanging below shoulders with neutral grip. Row both dumbbells to the ribcage, elbows close to body, squeeze the lats at the top. Controlled lower — no momentum.

name: Dumbbell Row — Overhand
setupNotes: Standing, hinge at hips with flat back, dumbbell in each hand with overhand grip (palms facing back). Row both dumbbells toward the lower ribs with elbows flared out. Overhand grip biases upper back, rear delts and rhomboids over lats.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
setupNotes: Standing, heavy dumbbells at sides. Shrug shoulders up toward ears, hold 1 second at top. Keep arms straight throughout.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
setupNotes: Flat bench, dumbbells with neutral grip above face. Lower dumbbells by bending elbows to beside ears, extend back up.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher — Standing
setupNotes: Standing tall, dumbbells held overhead with neutral grip, arms extended. Bend the elbows to lower the dumbbells beside the ears, elbows pinned forward and pointing up. Extend back up to lockout. Brace the core — standing variant adds full-body stability demand.

name: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise
setupNotes: Standing on edge of step or plate, dumbbell in one hand, other hand for balance. Rise onto toes, controlled lower. Alternate hands.
name_es: Elevación de gemelos — Mancuerna — De pie
name_pt: Elevação de panturrilha — Halter — Em pé

name: Dumbbell Thruster
setupNotes: Dumbbells racked at shoulders with neutral grip, feet shoulder-width. Squat to full depth, then drive up explosively and press the dumbbells to overhead lockout in one fluid motion. Full-body power.

name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
setupNotes: Right hand and right knee on flat bench, one side foot on floor, flat back. Dumbbell in one side hand, upper arm parallel to floor, elbow pinned to side. Extend one side forearm back to lockout, squeeze triceps. Controlled return.

name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback — Left Arm
setupNotes: Right hand and right knee on flat bench, left foot on floor, flat back. Dumbbell in left hand, upper arm parallel to floor, elbow pinned to side. Extend left forearm back to lockout, squeeze triceps. Controlled return.
name_es: Patada de tríceps — Mancuerna — Brazo izquierdo

name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback — Right Arm
setupNotes: Left hand and left knee on flat bench, right foot on floor, flat back. Dumbbell in right hand, upper arm parallel to floor, elbow pinned to side. Extend right forearm back to lockout, squeeze triceps. Controlled return.
name_es: Patada de tríceps — Mancuerna — Brazo derecho

name: Elliptical — Intervals
setupNotes: Elliptical machine. Alternate between high resistance/speed bursts and easy recovery. Use both handles for upper and lower body.

name: Elliptical — Reverse Pedal
setupNotes: Elliptical machine, pedal in reverse direction. Quad emphasis changes compared to forward motion. Grip handles for stability.

name: Elliptical — Steady
setupNotes: Elliptical machine. Feet on pedals, grip moving or stationary handles. Smooth pedalling motion. Moderate resistance, steady pace.

name: Explosive Push-Up
setupNotes: Standard push-up position on firm floor. Explode upward so hands leave the ground. Land softly with slight elbow bend. Advanced movement.

name: External Rotation — Band
setupNotes: Band anchored at elbow height, standing side-on so the anchor sits across your body. Hold the band in the working hand with the elbow pinned to your ribs and bent to 90 degrees, then rotate the forearm outward against the band. Keep the elbow glued to your side — trains the rotator cuff, infraspinatus and teres minor.

name: External Rotation — Band (Left Arm)
setupNotes: Anchor a band at elbow height to the right. Stand with the right side toward the anchor, hold the band in the left hand with the elbow pinned to the side and bent to 90 degrees. Rotate the forearm outward away from the body against the band. Trains the left rotator cuff (infraspinatus/teres minor).
name_es: Rotación externa — Con banda — Brazo izquierdo
name_pt: Rotação externa — Com elástico — Braço esquerdo

name: External Rotation — Band (Right Arm)
setupNotes: Anchor a band at elbow height to the left. Stand with the left side toward the anchor, hold the band in the right hand with the elbow pinned to the side and bent to 90 degrees. Rotate the forearm outward away from the body against the band. Trains the right rotator cuff (infraspinatus/teres minor).
name_es: Rotación externa — Con banda — Brazo derecho
name_pt: Rotação externa — Com elástico — Braço direito

name: EZ-Bar Curl — Standing — Narrow Grip
setupNotes: Standing, EZ-bar with comfortable wrist angle. Narrow Grip position. Curl to shoulders, squeeze at top, controlled eccentric.
name_es: Curl de bíceps — Barra Z — De pie — Agarre cerrado
name_fr: Curl — Barre EZ — Debout — Prise serrée
name_pt: Rosca direta — Barra W — Em pé — Pegada fechada

name: EZ-Bar Curl — Standing — Wide Grip
setupNotes: Standing, EZ-bar with comfortable wrist angle. Wide Grip position. Curl to shoulders, squeeze at top, controlled eccentric.
name_es: Curl de bíceps — Barra Z — De pie — Agarre ancho
name_fr: Curl — Barre EZ — Debout — Prise large
name_pt: Rosca direta — Barra W — Em pé — Pegada aberta

name: EZ-Bar Preacher Curl
setupNotes: Preacher curl bench, EZ-bar. Upper arms flat on pad, armpits at top of pad. Curl up, controlled lower — no momentum or bouncing at bottom.
name_es: Curl en banco Scott — Barra Z

name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
setupNotes: Flat or slight incline bench, EZ-bar. Grip at narrow angle. Lower to forehead, extend to lockout. EZ-bar reduces wrist strain.

name: EZ-Bar Upright Row
setupNotes: Standing, grip ez-bar at hip width. Pull straight up along body to chin level, elbows high.

name: Farmer's Walk
setupNotes: Standing, heavy dumbbell or farmer's walk handles in each hand at sides. Walk in straight line for distance or time. Tall posture, shoulders packed.

name: Fast Feet
setupNotes: Athletic stance, slightly bent knees. Rapid small steps in place, feet barely leaving ground. Fast as possible for prescribed time. Agility drill.

name: Fire Hydrant
setupNotes: Hands and knees position, spine neutral, hips stacked over the knees. Lift one knee out to the side keeping the 90-degree bend, squeezing the glute at the top. Keep the hips square — don't let the torso rotate open. Lower under control and alternate sides. Targets glute medius.

name: Fire Hydrant — Left
setupNotes: Hands and knees position, spine neutral. Lift the left knee out to the side keeping the 90-degree bend, squeezing the glute at top. Controlled lower — targets the left glute medius.
name_pt: Abdução de quadril — Quatro apoios — Esquerda

name: Fire Hydrant — Right
setupNotes: Hands and knees position, spine neutral. Lift the right knee out to the side keeping the 90-degree bend, squeezing the glute at top. Controlled lower — targets the right glute medius.
name_pt: Abdução de quadril — Quatro apoios — Direita

name: Flat Barbell Bench Press
setupNotes: Flat bench inside power rack or bench station. Bar at chest height, spotter recommended. Feet flat, shoulder blades retracted. Unrack, lower bar to mid-chest — press up to lockout.

name: Flat Dumbbell Bench Press
setupNotes: Flat bench with dumbbell rack nearby. Start with dumbbells on thighs, kick up to pressing position. Retract shoulder blades.

name: Flat Dumbbell Chest Fly
setupNotes: Flat bench with moderate dumbbells. Arms extended above chest, slight elbow bend. Lower in arc until stretch is felt.

name: Flat Machine Chest Press — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Flat chest press machine — adjust seat so handles align with mid-chest. Grip overhand with palms down, back against pad, feet flat. Press handles forward to full extension — targets chest with triceps assistance.
name_es: Press de pecho plano — Máquina — Agarre prono

name: Flat Slow Tempo Push-Up
setupNotes: Standard push-up position — hands shoulder-width on floor, body in straight line. Lower for 3–4 seconds, pause 1 second at bottom, press up with control. Tempo work builds chest time-under-tension.

name: Flutter Kicks
setupNotes: Lie face up, legs extended ~6 inches off floor. Alternate small up/down kicks rapidly. Lower back pressed into floor. Core endurance.

name: Foam Roll — Calves
setupNotes: Sit on the floor with a foam roller under one calf, the other leg crossed on top for extra pressure. Hands behind for support — lift the hips and roll slowly from the Achilles up to just below the knee. Rotate the leg in and out to reach the medial and lateral fibres. Releases the calves, each side.

name: Foam Roll — Calves — Left
setupNotes: Sit on the floor with a foam roller under the left calf, right leg crossed over the left for added pressure. Hands behind for support, lift the hips and roll from the Achilles up to just below the knee. Rotate the leg to hit medial and lateral fibres.
name_pt: Liberação miofascial com rolo — Panturrilhas — Esquerda

name: Foam Roll — Calves — Right
setupNotes: Sit on the floor with a foam roller under the right calf, left leg crossed over the right for added pressure. Hands behind for support, lift the hips and roll from the Achilles up to just below the knee. Rotate the leg to hit medial and lateral fibres.
name_pt: Liberação miofascial com rolo — Panturrilhas — Direita

name: Foam Roll — Glutes
setupNotes: Sit on a foam roller and cross one ankle over the opposite knee in a figure-4. Lean your weight into the working side and roll slowly over the glute, pausing on tender spots — stay relaxed rather than bracing against the roller. Targeted release for the glutes and piriformis.

name: Foam Roll — Glutes — Left
setupNotes: Sit on a foam roller, cross the left ankle over the right knee in a figure-4. Lean the weight toward the left side and roll slowly over the left glute, pausing on tender spots. Targeted release of the left glute and piriformis.
name_pt: Liberação miofascial com rolo — Glúteos — Esquerda

name: Foam Roll — Glutes — Right
setupNotes: Sit on a foam roller, cross the right ankle over the left knee in a figure-4. Lean the weight toward the right side and roll slowly over the right glute, pausing on tender spots. Targeted release of the right glute and piriformis.
name_pt: Liberação miofascial com rolo — Glúteos — Direita

name: Foam Roll — Hamstrings
setupNotes: Sit on floor, foam roller under back of thighs. Roll from just above knee to sit bones. Hands behind for support. Cross legs for more pressure.
name_pt: Liberação miofascial com rolo — Posteriores de coxa

name: Foam Roll — IT Band
setupNotes: Lie on your side with a foam roller under the outer thigh, top leg crossed over in front for support. Roll slowly from just above the knee up toward the hip, pausing on tender spots. Keep the pressure tolerable enough to keep breathing — releases the IT band and outer thigh. Switch sides.
name_pt: Liberação miofascial com rolo — Trato iliotibial

name: Foam Roll — IT Band — Left
setupNotes: Lie on the left side with a foam roller under the left outer thigh, right leg crossed over for support. Roll slowly from just above the knee up to the hip. Releases the left IT band — slow and tolerable.
name_fr: Rouleau de massage — Bandelette ilio-tibiale — Gauche
name_pt: Liberação miofascial com rolo — Trato iliotibial — Esquerda

name: Foam Roll — IT Band — Right
setupNotes: Lie on the right side with a foam roller under the right outer thigh, left leg crossed over for support. Roll slowly from just above the knee up to the hip. Releases the right IT band — slow and tolerable.
name_fr: Rouleau de massage — Bandelette ilio-tibiale — Droite
name_pt: Liberação miofascial com rolo — Trato iliotibial — Direita

name: Foam Roll — Lats
setupNotes: Lie on one side with a foam roller under the armpit and lat, that arm extended overhead. Roll slowly from the armpit down to the mid-ribcage, pausing on tender spots for a few breaths. Keep the ribcage from flaring. Releases the lat on each side.

name: Foam Roll — Lats — Left
setupNotes: Lie on the left side with a foam roller under the left armpit/lat area, left arm extended overhead. Roll slowly from the armpit down to the mid-ribcage, pausing on tender spots. Releases the left lat.
name_fr: Rouleau de massage — Grands dorsaux — Gauche
name_pt: Liberação miofascial com rolo — Dorsais — Esquerda

name: Foam Roll — Lats — Right
setupNotes: Lie on the right side with a foam roller under the right armpit/lat area, right arm extended overhead. Roll slowly from the armpit down to the mid-ribcage, pausing on tender spots. Releases the right lat.
name_fr: Rouleau de massage — Grands dorsaux — Droite
name_pt: Liberação miofascial com rolo — Dorsais — Direita

name: Foam Roll — Quads
setupNotes: Lie face down, foam roller under front of thighs. Roll from just above knee to hip flexor. Support weight with forearms. Pause on tight spots.

name: Foam Roll — Upper Back
setupNotes: Foam roller on floor. Lie on roller positioned under upper back. Arms crossed on chest. Roll from mid-back to upper traps. Pause on tight spots.
name_fr: Rouleau de massage — Haut du dos
name_pt: Liberação miofascial com rolo — Parte superior das costas

name: Forearm Plank
setupNotes: Elbows on floor under shoulders, forearms flat. Body straight from head to heels. Engage entire core, breathe steadily. Timed hold.

name: Forward Lunge — Barbell
setupNotes: Barbell racked across the upper back, feet hip-width, torso tall. Step one foot forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach roughly 90 degrees, then push through the front heel to return to standing. Keep the front knee tracking over the toes. Loads the front-leg quad and glute — alternate sides.

name: Forward Lunge — Barbell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall with a barbell on the upper back, feet hip-width. Step the left foot forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach ~90 degrees — front knee tracking over the toes. Push through the left heel to return to standing. Loads the left quad and glute under barbell load.
name_es: Zancada hacia delante — Barra — Pierna izquierda

name: Forward Lunge — Barbell — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall with a barbell on the upper back, feet hip-width. Step the right foot forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach ~90 degrees — front knee tracking over the toes. Push through the right heel to return to standing. Loads the right quad and glute under barbell load.
name_es: Zancada hacia delante — Barra — Pierna derecha

name: Forward Lunge — Bodyweight
setupNotes: Stand tall, feet hip-width, hands on the hips or at the sides. Step one foot forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees, then push through the front heel back to standing — front knee tracking over the toes. Loads the quads and glutes, alternating sides.

name: Forward Lunge — Bodyweight — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall, hands on hips or at sides. Step the left foot forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach ~90 degrees — front knee tracking over the toes. Push through the left heel to return to standing. Loads the left quad and glute.
name_es: Zancada hacia delante — Peso corporal — Pierna izquierda
name_fr: Fente avant — Poids du corps — Jambe gauche

name: Forward Lunge — Bodyweight — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall, hands on hips or at sides. Step the right foot forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach ~90 degrees — front knee tracking over the toes. Push through the right heel to return to standing. Loads the right quad and glute.
name_es: Zancada hacia delante — Peso corporal — Pierna derecha
name_fr: Fente avant — Poids du corps — Jambe droite

name: Forward Lunge — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, feet hip-width. Step one foot forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach ~90 degrees, front knee tracking over the toes. Push back through the front heel to return to standing. Loads the quad and glute of the working leg — alternate sides.

name: Forward Lunge — Dumbbell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall, dumbbell in each hand at sides. Step the left foot forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach ~90 degrees — front knee tracking over the toes. Push through the left heel to return to standing. Loads the left quad and glute.
name_es: Zancada hacia delante — Mancuerna — Pierna izquierda

name: Forward Lunge — Dumbbell — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall, dumbbell in each hand at sides. Step the right foot forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach ~90 degrees — front knee tracking over the toes. Push through the right heel to return to standing. Loads the right quad and glute.
name_es: Zancada hacia delante — Mancuerna — Pierna derecha

name: Frog Pump
setupNotes: Lie face up, soles of feet together, knees out to sides (frog position). Drive hips up squeezing glutes. Minimises hamstring involvement.

name: Front Pause Squat — Barbell
setupNotes: Power rack, front squat setup. Descend to bottom position, hold for 2-3 seconds without relaxing tension, then drive up. Builds strength off bottom.

name: Front Raise — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbells in front of thighs. Raise one or both arms forward to shoulder height, palms down. Controlled lowering.

name: Front Raise — Plate
setupNotes: Standing, grip a weight plate at 3 and 9 o'clock. Raise to shoulder height with arms extended. Controlled tempo.

name: GHD Back Extension
setupNotes: Glute-Ham Developer machine. Pad at hip crease, feet anchored on platform. Hinge at hips, lower torso, extend back to horizontal or slight hyperextension.

name: Glute Bridge
setupNotes: Lie face up, knees bent, feet flat on floor hip-width. Drive hips up squeezing glutes at top. Lower controlled. Floor exercise.

name: Glute Bridge — Elevated
setupNotes: Same as standard bridge but feet placed on sturdy chair, bench, or step. Increases range of motion and difficulty.

name: Glute Bridge — Single-Leg
setupNotes: Lie face up with one foot planted hip-width, the other knee raised or that leg extended toward the ceiling. Drive the hips up through the planted heel until the body forms a straight line, squeezing the glute hard at the top. Keep the pelvis level. Lower under control and repeat each side.
name_es: Puente de glúteos a una pierna

name: Glute Bridge — Single-Leg — Left Leg
setupNotes: Lie face up, left foot planted hip-width, right knee raised or right leg extended toward the ceiling. Drive the hips up through the left heel until the body is in a straight line, squeeze the left glute hard at the top. Lower under control.
name_es: Puente de glúteos a una pierna — Pierna izquierda
name_fr: Pont fessier à une jambe — Jambe gauche
name_pt: Ponte de glúteos unilateral — Perna esquerda

name: Glute Bridge — Single-Leg — Right Leg
setupNotes: Lie face up, right foot planted hip-width, left knee raised or left leg extended toward the ceiling. Drive the hips up through the right heel until the body is in a straight line, squeeze the right glute hard at the top. Lower under control.
name_es: Puente de glúteos a una pierna — Pierna derecha
name_fr: Pont fessier à une jambe — Jambe droite
name_pt: Ponte de glúteos unilateral — Perna direita

name: Glute Kickback Machine
setupNotes: Standing or kneeling at glute kickback machine. Pad behind one side ankle or knee. Push one side leg back and up, squeezing one side glute at top. Controlled return.

name: Glute Kickback Machine — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing or kneeling at glute kickback machine. Pad behind left ankle or knee. Push left leg back and up, squeezing left glute at top. Controlled return.
name_es: Patada de glúteo — Máquina — Pierna izquierda
name_pt: Coice de glúteo — Máquina — Perna esquerda

name: Glute Kickback Machine — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing or kneeling at glute kickback machine. Pad behind right ankle or knee. Push right leg back and up, squeezing right glute at top. Controlled return.
name_es: Patada de glúteo — Máquina — Pierna derecha
name_pt: Coice de glúteo — Máquina — Perna direita

name: Glute Stretch — Figure 4
setupNotes: Lie face up with knees bent. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee into a figure-4, reach through and pull the supporting thigh toward the chest until a stretch builds deep in the crossed-side glute. Keep the head and shoulders relaxed on the floor. Hold, then switch sides — targets the piriformis.

name: Glute Stretch — Figure 4 — Left
setupNotes: Lie face up with knees bent. Cross the left ankle over the right knee in a figure-4. Reach through and pull the right thigh toward the chest until a stretch is felt deep in the left glute. Hold. Targets the left piriformis.

name: Glute Stretch — Figure 4 — Right
setupNotes: Lie face up with knees bent. Cross the right ankle over the left knee in a figure-4. Reach through and pull the left thigh toward the chest until a stretch is felt deep in the right glute. Hold. Targets the right piriformis.

name: Goblet Squat — B-Stance
setupNotes: Standing with one foot half a step behind (heel up, toe lightly anchored), hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at chest height with both hands. Squat down driving mainly through the front leg. Unilateral emphasis with bilateral stability.

name: Goblet Squat — Elevated Heels
setupNotes: Standing on a small plate or wedge with heels elevated, hold one dumbbell or kettlebell at chest height with both hands. Squat down, elbows inside knees at bottom. Elevated heels bias load onto the quads.

name: Goblet Squat — Standard
setupNotes: Standing, hold one dumbbell or kettlebell at chest height with both hands. Feet shoulder-width. Squat down, elbows inside knees at bottom. Standard stance.

name: Hack Squat — Machine
setupNotes: Hack squat machine, shoulders under pads, back against pad. Feet shoulder-width on platform. Descend to parallel or below, press up.

name: Hack Squat Machine — Narrow Stance
setupNotes: Hack squat machine, shoulders under pads, back against pad. Feet narrow on platform, close together. Descend to parallel or below, press up — emphasizes outer quads.

name: Hack Squat Machine — Wide Stance
setupNotes: Hack squat machine, shoulders under pads, back against pad. Feet wide on platform, toes slightly out. Descend to parallel or below, press up — emphasizes inner thighs and glutes.

name: Half-Kneeling Landmine Press
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment or wedged in corner. Half-kneel facing the bar (one knee down, opposite foot forward). Grip the bar end with both hands at chin. Press diagonally upward to full extension — challenges core and shoulder stability through the offset stance.
name_fr: Développé landmine — Un genou au sol

name: Hamstring Stretch — Seated
setupNotes: Sit on the floor with the working leg extended and the opposite foot tucked against the inner thigh. Hinge from the hips and reach out over the extended leg — keep the back flat instead of rounding through the spine. Hold and breathe, then switch sides to stretch each hamstring.
name_pt: Alongamento de posteriores de coxa — Sentado

name: Hamstring Stretch — Seated — Left
setupNotes: Sit on the floor with the left leg extended and the right foot tucked against the inner left thigh. Hinge at the hips and reach over the left leg, back flat. Hold and breathe. Targets the left hamstring.
name_pt: Alongamento de posteriores de coxa — Sentado — Esquerda

name: Hamstring Stretch — Seated — Right
setupNotes: Sit on the floor with the right leg extended and the left foot tucked against the inner right thigh. Hinge at the hips and reach over the right leg, back flat. Hold and breathe. Targets the right hamstring.
name_pt: Alongamento de posteriores de coxa — Sentado — Direita

name: Hamstring Stretch — Standing
setupNotes: Stand and place one heel on a low bench or step with that leg straight, toes pulled up. Hinge from the hips and lean the chest forward over the working leg, keeping the back flat instead of rounding. Hold and breathe into the stretch — targets the hamstring. Switch sides.
name_pt: Alongamento de posteriores de coxa — Em pé

name: Hamstring Stretch — Standing — Left
setupNotes: Standing, place the left heel on a low bench or step with the leg straight. Hinge from the hips and lean forward over the left leg, keeping the back flat. Hold. Targets the left hamstring.
name_es: Estiramiento de isquiotibiales — De pie — Izquierda
name_pt: Alongamento de posteriores de coxa — Em pé — Esquerda

name: Hamstring Stretch — Standing — Right
setupNotes: Standing, place the right heel on a low bench or step with the leg straight. Hinge from the hips and lean forward over the right leg, keeping the back flat. Hold. Targets the right hamstring.
name_es: Estiramiento de isquiotibiales — De pie — Derecha
name_pt: Alongamento de posteriores de coxa — Em pé — Direita

name: Hang Clean
setupNotes: Barbell at hip level in standing position. Dip-drive hips, explosively pull bar upward, catch on front delts in front rack. Start from hang, not floor.

name: Hanging Hamstring Stretch with Core Activation
setupNotes: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms, legs straight beneath you. Raise one leg to about parallel with the floor, hold to engage the core, then lower under control. Stretches hamstrings while activating the abs.
name_es: Estiramiento de isquiotibiales con activación del core — Colgado
name_fr: Étirement suspendu des ischio-jambiers avec activation abdominale
name_pt: Alongamento de posteriores de coxa — Suspenso — Com ativação do core

name: Hanging Hamstring Stretch with Core Activation — Left
setupNotes: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms, legs straight beneath you. Raise left leg to about parallel with the floor, hold to engage the core, then lower under control. Stretches hamstrings while activating the abs.
name_es: Estiramiento de isquiotibiales con activación del core — Colgado — Izquierda
name_fr: Étirement suspendu des ischio-jambiers avec activation abdominale — Gauche
name_pt: Alongamento de posteriores de coxa — Suspenso — Com ativação do core — Esquerda
parentName: Hanging Hamstring Stretch with Core Activation

name: Hanging Hamstring Stretch with Core Activation — Right
setupNotes: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms, legs straight beneath you. Raise right leg to about parallel with the floor, hold to engage the core, then lower under control. Stretches hamstrings while activating the abs.
name_es: Estiramiento de isquiotibiales con activación del core — Colgado — Derecha
name_fr: Étirement suspendu des ischio-jambiers avec activation abdominale — Droite
name_pt: Alongamento de posteriores de coxa — Suspenso — Com ativação do core — Direita
parentName: Hanging Hamstring Stretch with Core Activation

name: Hanging Knee Raise
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar with straight arms. Bring knees up to chest level. Controlled lower, avoid swinging. Flex abs, don't just swing legs.

name: Hanging Knee Raise — Side-to-Side
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar. Bring knees up and twist to one side, lower, repeat to other side. Oblique emphasis on the hanging knee raise.
name_de: Hängendes Knieheben — Von Seite zu Seite
name_es: Elevación de rodillas — Colgado — De lado a lado
name_fr: Relevé de genoux suspendu — D'un côté à l'autre
name_pt: Elevação de joelhos — Suspenso — De lado a lado

name: Hanging Straight Leg Raise
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar, legs fully straight. Raise legs to horizontal or higher. Controlled lower. Avoid using momentum.

name: Hanging Windshield Wipers
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar, raise legs to horizontal. Sweep legs side to side like windshield wipers. Advanced rotational core exercise.

name: Heel Slide with Core Bracing
setupNotes: Same as standard heel slide. Actively brace core (draw navel in) before each slide. Focus on preventing any pelvic movement.
name_es: Deslizamiento de talón con activación del core
name_pt: Deslizamento de calcanhar com contração do core

name: High Cable Curl
setupNotes: Dual cable station, pulleys set high with D-handles. Stand centred, arms extended to sides. Curl handles toward ears — front double bicep position.

name: High Knee March
setupNotes: Standing, drive knees above hip level alternately. Pump arms opposite to legs. Moderate pace. Hip flexor activation and warm-up.

name: High Knee Tuck Jumps
setupNotes: Standing, jump explosively pulling both knees to chest at peak. Land softly with bent knees. Advanced plyometric.

name: High Knees
setupNotes: Standing, drive knees above hip height rapidly alternating legs. Pump arms. Fast pace. On the spot or moving slightly forward.

name: High Knees + Lateral Shuffle
setupNotes: Combine high knees with lateral shuffling steps. High knees for 4 steps, shuffle 4 steps sideways, repeat. Agility and cardio.

name: High Plank
setupNotes: Hands under shoulders, arms straight. Body straight, push floor away. Engage core, avoid sagging hips. Foundation position for many exercises.

name: High Plank Knee Drives
setupNotes: High plank position. Drive one knee toward chest quickly, return, repeat other knee. Mountain-climber style from plank. Controlled.
name_es: Plancha alta con rodillas al pecho
name_fr: Planche haute genoux à la poitrine
name_pt: Prancha alta com joelhos ao peito

name: High Side Plank
setupNotes: Lie on side with bottom hand on floor directly under shoulder, arm fully straight. Stack or stagger feet. Press the floor away and lift hips into a straight line — top arm extended overhead or on hip. Targets obliques and shoulder stability.

name: High Side Plank — Left Side
setupNotes: Lie on side with bottom hand on floor directly under shoulder, arm fully straight. Stack or stagger feet. Press the floor away and lift hips into a straight line — top arm extended overhead or on hip. Targets obliques and shoulder stability.

name: High Side Plank — Right Side
setupNotes: Lie on side with bottom hand on floor directly under shoulder, arm fully straight. Stack or stagger feet. Press the floor away and lift hips into a straight line — top arm extended overhead or on hip. Targets obliques and shoulder stability.

name: Hip Abductor Machine
setupNotes: Seated hip abduction machine. Sit with outer thighs against pads. Push legs outward against resistance, controlled return. Targets glute medius.

name: Hip Adductor Machine
setupNotes: Seated hip adduction machine. Sit with inner thighs against pads. Squeeze legs together against resistance, controlled release. Inner thigh focus.

name: Hip Circles
setupNotes: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hands on hips. Rotate hips in large smooth circles — clockwise then counterclockwise. Keep upper body stable. Warms up hip joints and lower back.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch
setupNotes: Half-kneeling on a mat — rear knee down, front foot planted flat ahead. Tuck the pelvis under and push the hips gently forward until a stretch builds at the front of the rear hip. Stay tall through the torso instead of arching the lower back. Hold, then switch sides.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch — Left Hip
setupNotes: Half-kneeling on the mat — left knee down, right foot forward. Tuck the pelvis under and gently push the hips forward until a stretch is felt at the front of the left hip. Stay tall through the torso. Hold. Stretches the left hip flexor.
name_es: Estiramiento de flexores de cadera — Cadera izquierda
name_fr: Étirement du fléchisseur de hanche — Hanche gauche
name_pt: Alongamento de flexores do quadril — Quadril esquerdo

name: Hip Flexor Stretch — Right Hip
setupNotes: Half-kneeling on the mat — right knee down, left foot forward. Tuck the pelvis under and gently push the hips forward until a stretch is felt at the front of the right hip. Stay tall through the torso. Hold. Stretches the right hip flexor.
name_es: Estiramiento de flexores de cadera — Cadera derecha
name_fr: Étirement du fléchisseur de hanche — Hanche droite
name_pt: Alongamento de flexores do quadril — Quadril direito

name: Hollow Body Hold
setupNotes: Lie face up, arms extended overhead, legs straight. Lift shoulders and legs off floor, lower back pressed into ground. Banana shape. Hold.

name: Hollow Rock
setupNotes: Full hollow body position — arms overhead, legs extended, both off floor. Rock forward and back maintaining rigid body shape.

name: Inchworm
setupNotes: Standing, fold forward touching floor. Walk hands out to plank position. Optional push-up. Walk feet to hands, stand up. Full body warm-up.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
setupNotes: Incline bench (30-45 degrees) inside power rack. Bar at chest height, spotter recommended. Feet flat, shoulder blades retracted. Unrack, lower bar to upper chest — press up to lockout.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press — Narrow-Close Grip
setupNotes: Incline bench (30-45 degrees) inside power rack. Hands narrower than shoulders on the bar. Unrack, lower bar to upper chest with elbows tucked, press up to lockout — emphasises triceps and upper-chest fibres.
name_es: Press de banca inclinado — Barra — Agarre cerrado

name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
setupNotes: Incline bench with dumbbell rack nearby. Start with dumbbells on thighs, kick up to pressing position. Retract shoulder blades.

name: Incline Dumbbell Chest Fly
setupNotes: Incline bench with moderate dumbbells. Arms extended above chest, slight elbow bend. Lower in arc until stretch is felt.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl — Seated
setupNotes: Seated on incline bench at ~45-60 degrees. Dumbbells hang at sides behind torso. Curl up, long head of biceps gets extra stretch.
name_es: Curl en banco inclinado — Mancuerna — Sentado
name_pt: Rosca no banco inclinado — Halter — Sentado

name: Incline Hammer Curl
setupNotes: Seated on incline bench at ~45 degrees. Dumbbells at sides with neutral grip. Curl up — incline increases stretch on brachialis.

name: Incline Hammer Curl — Simultaneous
setupNotes: Seated on an incline bench set to roughly 45-60 degrees, a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral (palms-facing) hammer grip, arms hanging back behind the torso. Curl both arms up at the same time, thumbs pointing up, then lower under control — both arms move together every rep. The incline stretches the long head, biasing the biceps and brachialis.
name_es: Curl martillo en banco inclinado — Simultáneo
name_pt: Rosca martelo no banco inclinado — Simultânea

name: Incline Machine Chest Press — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Incline chest press machine — adjust seat so handles align with upper chest. Grip overhand with palms down, back against pad, feet flat. Press handles forward and slightly up — targets upper chest and front delts.
name_es: Press de pecho inclinado — Máquina — Agarre prono

name: Incline Pec Fly
setupNotes: Pec deck / fly machine set to an incline pad position (or use an incline-bench machine). Adjust seat so handles align with the upper chest, back firmly against pad, slight elbow bend. Bring handles together in a wide arc in front of the upper chest — emphasises clavicular (upper) chest fibres.

name: Incline Plank (Hands Elevated)
setupNotes: Hands on bench, box, or chair in plank position. Easier regression of floor plank. Good for beginners building core strength.

name: Incline Push-Up
setupNotes: Hands on bench, box, or sturdy elevated surface. Feet on floor. Straight body line. Easier regression — lower surface = harder. Full range of motion.

name: Incline Slow Tempo Push-Up
setupNotes: Hands elevated on bench or box, feet on floor, body in straight line. Lower chest toward bench for 3–4 seconds, pause 1 second at bottom, press up with control. Tempo work builds lower-chest endurance at an easier angle.

name: Incline Treadmill Walk
setupNotes: Treadmill at walking speed with incline raised (8-15%). Walk uphill. Do not hold handrails for full benefit. Glute and cardio emphasis.
name_es: Cinta de correr — Con inclinación — Caminar

name: Internal Rotation — Band
setupNotes: Band anchored at elbow height, standing side-on with the working arm nearest the anchor. Elbow pinned to the ribs and bent to 90 degrees, rotate the forearm inward across the body against the band, then return slowly. Keep the elbow glued to the side. Trains the subscapularis and rotator cuff, each side.

name: Internal Rotation — Band (Left Arm)
setupNotes: Anchor a band at elbow height to the left. Stand with the left side toward the anchor, hold the band in the left hand with the elbow pinned to the side and bent to 90 degrees. Rotate the forearm inward across the body against the band. Trains the left subscapularis.
name_es: Rotación interna — Con banda — Brazo izquierdo
name_pt: Rotação interna — Com elástico — Braço esquerdo

name: Internal Rotation — Band (Right Arm)
setupNotes: Anchor a band at elbow height to the right. Stand with the right side toward the anchor, hold the band in the right hand with the elbow pinned to the side and bent to 90 degrees. Rotate the forearm inward across the body against the band. Trains the right subscapularis.
name_es: Rotación interna — Con banda — Brazo derecho
name_pt: Rotação interna — Com elástico — Braço direito

name: Inverted Row — Feet Elevated
setupNotes: Same as standard inverted row but feet on bench or box. Increases difficulty by raising body angle closer to horizontal.

name: Inverted Row — Single-Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in rack. Grip bar with one hand, other arm at side or behind back. Row body up with one arm. Advanced unilateral.

name: Inverted Row — Single-Arm — Left Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in rack. Grip bar with one hand, other arm at side or behind back. Row body up with one arm. Advanced unilateral.
name_es: Remo invertido a un brazo — Brazo izquierdo
name_fr: Rowing inversé à un bras — Bras gauche

name: Inverted Row — Single-Arm — Right Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in rack. Grip bar with one hand, other arm at side or behind back. Row body up with one arm. Advanced unilateral.
name_es: Remo invertido a un brazo — Brazo derecho
name_fr: Rowing inversé à un bras — Bras droit

name: Inverted Row — Standard — Neutral Grip
setupNotes: Barbell in rack at waist height, or Smith machine bar. Hang underneath, body straight. Pull chest to bar. Use neutral grip position.

name: Inverted Row — Standard — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Barbell in rack at waist height, or Smith machine bar. Hang underneath, body straight. Pull chest to bar. Use overhand grip position.

name: Inverted Row — Standard — Underhand Grip
setupNotes: Barbell in rack at waist height, or Smith machine bar. Hang underneath, body straight. Pull chest to bar. Use underhand grip position.

name: Inverted Row — Weighted
setupNotes: Standard inverted row setup. Place weight plate on chest or wear weighted vest for additional resistance.

name: Iso-Lateral Bench Press
setupNotes: Iso-lateral (independent-arm) plate-loaded chest press, flat setting. Adjust seat so handles align with mid-chest, feet flat, back against pad. Press one handle at a time or both together — independent arms force each side to do its own work. Targets chest with triceps assistance.

name: Iso-Lateral Incline Machine Chest Press
setupNotes: Iso-lateral (independent-arm) plate-loaded chest press, incline setting. Adjust seat so handles align with the upper chest, feet flat, back against pad. Press one handle at a time or both together to full extension — targets upper chest and front delts with no left/right cheating.
name_es: Press de pecho inclinado iso-lateral — Máquina

name: Iso-Lateral Low Row — Neutral Grip
setupNotes: Iso-lateral (independent-arm) plate-loaded low row. Chest against pad, feet on platform. Grip handles with a neutral (palms-facing) grip. Pull handles to the ribs, elbows tracking close to body — squeeze shoulder blades. Targets mid-back and lats.

name: Iso-Lateral Low Row — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Iso-lateral (independent-arm) plate-loaded low row. Chest against pad, feet on platform. Grip handles with an overhand (pronated) grip. Pull handles to the ribs with elbows flared slightly — emphasises rear delts and upper back.

name: Iso-Lateral Low Row — Underhand Grip
setupNotes: Iso-lateral (independent-arm) plate-loaded low row. Chest against pad, feet on platform. Grip handles with an underhand (supinated) grip. Pull handles to the lower ribs with elbows tucked close to body — biceps assist, emphasises lats.

name: Iso-Lateral Super Incline Press
setupNotes: Iso-lateral (independent-arm) plate-loaded shoulder-press machine, super-incline / near-vertical setting. Adjust seat so handles align with the shoulders, feet flat, back against pad. Press handles overhead one at a time or together — targets shoulders with upper-chest assistance.

name: Isometric Lateral Hold — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Standing, raise light dumbbells to shoulder height laterally. Hold position for prescribed time. Maintain slight elbow bend.
name_fr: Maintien isométrique en élévation latérale — Haltère

name: Jump Squat
setupNotes: Feet shoulder-width, squat down, explode upward leaving the ground. Land softly in squat position. Repeat. Quad and glute power.

name: Jumping Jacks
setupNotes: Standing, feet together, arms at sides. Jump feet apart while raising arms overhead, jump back. Classic cardio warm-up. Continuous rhythm.

name: Jumping Lunge
setupNotes: Start in lunge position. Jump explosively, switch legs mid-air, land in opposite lunge. Continuous. Plyometric cardio and leg power.

name: Jumping / Plyo Lunge
setupNotes: Start in lunge position. Jump explosively, switch legs mid-air, land in opposite lunge. Continuous alternating. Cardio and power.

name: Kegel — Endurance Set
setupNotes: Seated or supine. Contract pelvic floor and hold for increasing durations (10, 15, 20 seconds). Full relaxation between holds.

name: Kegel — Quick Flicks
setupNotes: Same position. Rapidly contract and release pelvic floor muscles. 1-second hold, 1-second release. Builds fast-twitch pelvic floor response.

name: Kegel — Slow Hold
setupNotes: Seated or supine. Contract pelvic floor muscles (as if stopping urine flow). Hold for 5-10 seconds, fully relax for same duration. Repeat.

name: Kettlebell Clean
setupNotes: Single kettlebell on the floor between the feet. Hinge, grip the handle with one hand and swing the bell back between the legs, then drive the hips and pull it up so it rotates and lands softly in the rack on the forearm — keep it close to the body so it never flips onto the wrist. Trains explosive hip drive and unilateral grip.

name: Kettlebell Clean — Left
setupNotes: Single kettlebell on the floor between the feet. Hinge and grip with the left hand, swing the bell back between the legs, then drive the hips and pull the bell up — rotate the wrist so it lands softly in the rack on the left forearm and shoulder. Lower under control. Trains explosive hip drive and unilateral grip.

name: Kettlebell Clean — Right
setupNotes: Single kettlebell on the floor between the feet. Hinge and grip with the right hand, swing the bell back between the legs, then drive the hips and pull the bell up — rotate the wrist so it lands softly in the rack on the right forearm and shoulder. Lower under control. Trains explosive hip drive and unilateral grip.

name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
setupNotes: Standing, kettlebell in each hand or single kettlebell in both. Same hip hinge pattern. Kettlebell shape allows natural hand position.

name: Kettlebell Snatch
setupNotes: Single kettlebell on floor. Explosive swing directly overhead in one motion. Lock out at top, controlled lower through swing. One arm at a time.

name: Kettlebell Snatch — Left Arm
setupNotes: Single kettlebell on the floor between the feet. Hinge and grip with the left hand, swing the bell back between the legs, then drive the hips and pull the bell straight overhead in one motion — punch through at the top so it lands softly on the back of the wrist with the arm locked. Controlled lower through the swing.

name: Kettlebell Snatch — Right Arm
setupNotes: Single kettlebell on the floor between the feet. Hinge and grip with the right hand, swing the bell back between the legs, then drive the hips and pull the bell straight overhead in one motion — punch through at the top so it lands softly on the back of the wrist with the arm locked. Controlled lower through the swing.

name: Kettlebell Swing
setupNotes: Standing, kettlebell on floor between feet. Hike KB back between legs, drive hips forward explosively to swing KB to chest/eye height. Hinge, not squat.

name: Knee Push-Up
setupNotes: Hands on floor shoulder-width, knees on mat. Straight line from head to knees. Lower chest to floor, press up. Beginner progression.

name: Kneeling Ab Wheel Rollout
setupNotes: Kneeling, grip ab wheel. Roll forward extending body toward floor, pull back using core. Prevent lower back sag.

name: Kneeling Cable Crunch
setupNotes: High cable pulley, rope attachment. Kneel facing machine, rope behind head. Crunch forward, curling torso, elbows toward knees. Control eccentric.

name: Kneeling Cable Face Pull
setupNotes: Cable at upper-chest height, rope attachment. Pull toward face, hands ending beside ears. Elbows high, squeeze rear delts. Kneeling.

name: Kneeling Cable Woodchop
setupNotes: Cable at high or low position. Kneel sideways, chop diagonally across body. Kneeling removes leg drive, isolates obliques and trunk rotation.

name: Kneeling Cable Woodchop — Left
setupNotes: Cable at high pulley with rope or D-handle. Half-kneel with the right knee down, right side toward the stack, both hands on the handle overhead-right. Pull diagonally across and down to the low-left hip, rotating through the torso. Kneeling removes leg drive — isolates obliques.

name: Kneeling Cable Woodchop — Right
setupNotes: Cable at high pulley with rope or D-handle. Half-kneel with the left knee down, left side toward the stack, both hands on the handle overhead-left. Pull diagonally across and down to the low-right hip, rotating through the torso. Kneeling removes leg drive — isolates obliques.

name: Kneeling Double-Arm Landmine Chest Press
setupNotes: Barbell loaded into a landmine attachment or wedged in a corner. Tall-kneel facing the bar with both knees on the floor, both hands cupped around the end of the bar at the chest. Press forward and up in a roughly horizontal arc to full extension, then lower under control — the kneeling base removes leg drive and raises core demand while emphasising the chest (pecs) and front delts.
name_es: Press de pecho landmine a dos brazos — Arrodillado
name_fr: Développé poitrine landmine à deux bras — À genoux

name: Kneeling Double-Arm Landmine Shoulder Press
setupNotes: Barbell loaded into a landmine attachment or wedged in a corner. Tall-kneel facing the bar with both knees on the floor, both hands cupped around the end of the bar at the chest. Press more vertically toward overhead to full extension, then lower under control — the kneeling base removes leg drive and stacks core demand while targeting the shoulders (delts).
name_es: Press de hombros landmine a dos brazos — Arrodillado
name_fr: Développé épaules landmine à deux bras — À genoux

name: Kneeling Landmine Press
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment or wedged in corner. Half-kneel facing the bar, grip end of bar at chest with both hands. Press up and forward in an arc to full extension — targets upper chest and front delts while removing lower-body drive.

name: Kneeling Single-Arm Landmine Press — Chest
setupNotes: Barbell loaded into a landmine attachment or wedged in a corner, gripping the end of the bar with one hand. Tall-kneel facing the bar with both knees on the mat, the working arm racked at shoulder height, free hand on the thigh. Press the bar forward and up in a roughly horizontal arc to full extension, then lower under control. Loads the chest and front delt with strong unilateral core and anti-rotation demand.
name_es: Press de pecho landmine a un brazo — Arrodillado
name_fr: Développé landmine à un bras — À genoux — Poitrine

name: Kneeling Single-Arm Landmine Press — Chest — Left Arm
setupNotes: Barbell loaded into a landmine attachment or wedged in a corner, gripping the end of the bar with the left hand. Tall-kneel facing the bar with both knees on the mat, left arm racked at shoulder height, right hand resting on the thigh. Press the bar forward and up in a roughly horizontal arc to full extension, then lower under control. Loads the left chest and front delt with strong core and anti-rotation demand.
name_es: Press de pecho landmine a un brazo — Arrodillado — Brazo izquierdo

setupNotes: One hand on bench or rack for support. Heavy dumbbell, slight torso rotation allowed. High-rep, explosive rowing for back thickness.

name: Kroc Row — Right Arm
setupNotes: One hand on bench or rack for support. Heavy dumbbell, slight torso rotation allowed. High-rep, explosive rowing for back thickness.

name: L-Sit Hang
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar. Raise straight legs to horizontal (L position) and hold. Timed isometric. Core and hip flexor endurance.

name: L-Sit Pull-Up
setupNotes: Hang from a pull-up bar with shoulder-width overhand grip. Raise legs to a 90-degree L-sit and hold the position throughout. Pull chest to bar keeping legs locked out — lower with control. Advanced — combines isometric core hold with vertical pull.

name: Lacrosse Ball — Piriformis
setupNotes: Sit on a lacrosse ball placed under one glute, ankle of that side crossed over the opposite knee in a figure-4. Roll gently over the area or hold steady pressure on the tender spot. Only load it as far as you can stay relaxed and breathing — releases the piriformis and deep hip. Switch sides.

name: Lacrosse Ball — Piriformis — Left
setupNotes: Sit on a lacrosse ball positioned under the left glute/piriformis, left ankle crossed over the right knee in a figure-4. Roll gently or hold pressure on the tender spot. Releases the left piriformis.
name_pt: Liberação miofascial com bola de lacrosse — Piriforme — Esquerda

name: Lacrosse Ball — Piriformis — Right
setupNotes: Sit on a lacrosse ball positioned under the right glute/piriformis, right ankle crossed over the left knee in a figure-4. Roll gently or hold pressure on the tender spot. Releases the right piriformis.
name_pt: Liberação miofascial com bola de lacrosse — Piriforme — Direita

name: Lacrosse Ball — Shoulder/Rear Delt
setupNotes: Stand with a lacrosse ball pinned between the wall and the rear delt or upper back on one side. Lean into the ball to apply pressure and roll in small circles to hunt out tight spots. Breathe out into tender areas rather than bracing against them. Releases rear delt and upper trap.
name_es: Pelota de lacrosse — Hombro y deltoides posterior
name_fr: Balle de lacrosse — Épaule et deltoïde postérieur
name_pt: Liberação miofascial com bola de lacrosse — Ombro e deltoide posterior

name: Lacrosse Ball — Shoulder/Rear Delt — Left
setupNotes: Stand with a lacrosse ball pinned between the left upper back/rear delt and a wall. Lean into the ball to apply pressure and roll in small circles to find tight spots. Releases the left rear delt and upper trap.

name: Landmine Rotation
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment. Hold end of bar with both hands at chest level. Rotate torso, moving bar in arc from side to side. Controlled.

name: Lat Pulldown — Neutral/Close Grip
setupNotes: V-handle or close-grip attachment on lat pulldown. Sit upright, pull to chest, elbows close to body. Squeeze at bottom.
name_es: Jalón al pecho — Agarre neutro cerrado

name: Lat Pulldown — Reverse Grip — Close Grip
setupNotes: Straight bar on lat pulldown, underhand (supinated) grip, hands close together. Pull bar to upper chest — lean back slightly, squeeze lats at bottom.
name_es: Jalón al pecho — Agarre invertido cerrado

name: Lat Pulldown — Reverse Grip — Standard Grip
setupNotes: Straight bar on lat pulldown, underhand (supinated) grip, hands shoulder-width apart. Pull bar to upper chest — lean back slightly, squeeze lats at bottom.
name_es: Jalón al pecho — Agarre invertido estándar

name: Lat Pulldown — Wide Grip
setupNotes: Cable lat pulldown machine, wide bar attached. Sit with thighs under pad, grip bar wider than shoulder-width. Pull to upper chest, squeeze lats.

name: Lateral Band Walk
setupNotes: Mini resistance band around ankles or just above knees. Quarter squat athletic stance. Step sideways maintaining band tension. Continuous side steps.

name: Lateral Raise — Cable
setupNotes: Two low cable pulleys, a D-handle on each. Stand centered between them with the cables crossed in front — each hand holds the opposite-side handle. Raise both arms out to the sides to shoulder height at the same time, then lower under control. Constant cable tension throughout.

name: Lateral Raise — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Standing, light dumbbells at sides. Raise arms out to sides until parallel with floor, slight bend in elbows. Controlled lowering.

name: Lateral Squat
setupNotes: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes pointing forward. Shift the weight across to one side, bending that knee into a deep side squat while the trailing leg stays extended. Push through the loaded heel to return to centre, then alternate sides. Loads the adductors, quads and glutes.

name: Lateral Squat — Left Leg
setupNotes: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes forward. Shift the weight to the left, bending the left knee into a deep side squat while the right leg stays straight. Push through the left heel to return to centre. Loads the left adductor and glute.

name: Lateral Squat — Right Leg
setupNotes: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes forward. Shift the weight to the right, bending the right knee into a deep side squat while the left leg stays straight. Push through the right heel to return to centre. Loads the right adductor and glute.

name: Lateral Step-Up
setupNotes: Stand with bench/box on your one side side. Step up sideways with one side foot onto box, drive through one side glute to stand fully, controlled step down. All reps on one side side.

name: Lateral Step-Up — Left Leg
setupNotes: Stand with bench/box on your left side. Step up sideways with left foot onto box, drive through left glute to stand fully, controlled step down. All reps on left side.

name_pt: Subida lateral no banco — Perna esquerda

name: Lateral Step-Up — Right Leg

name_pt: Subida lateral no banco — Perna direita

name: Leaning Lateral Raise
setupNotes: Stand beside a rack post or cable column, gripping it with the free hand and leaning the body away until the torso angles out. Light dumbbell in the working hand, arm hanging across the body — raise it out to the side to shoulder height, leading with the elbow, then lower slowly. The lean adds range at the bottom and keeps constant tension on the side delt.

name: Leaning Lateral Raise — Left
setupNotes: Standing beside a rack post or cable column, hold the post with the right hand and lean the body away to the left. Light dumbbell in the left hand, arm hanging. Raise the left arm out to the side to shoulder height — leaning increases the range of motion at the bottom and constant tension on the medial delt.

name: Leaning Lateral Raise — Right
setupNotes: Standing beside a rack post or cable column, hold the post with the left hand and lean the body away to the right. Light dumbbell in the right hand, arm hanging. Raise the right arm out to the side to shoulder height — leaning increases the range of motion at the bottom and constant tension on the medial delt.

name: Leg Extension — Seated (Double-Leg)
setupNotes: Seated leg extension machine. Shin pad on lower shins. Extend legs to full lockout, squeeze quads at top, controlled lower.
name_es: Extensión de cuádriceps a dos piernas — Sentado

name: Leg Extension — Single-Leg
setupNotes: Seated leg extension machine, shin pad low on the working shin, the other leg relaxed off to the side. Extend the working leg to full lockout, squeeze the quad hard at the top, then lower under control. Use a lighter load than bilateral — exposes and corrects side-to-side quad imbalances.
name_es: Extensión de cuádriceps a una pierna

name: Leg Extension — Single-Leg — Left Leg
setupNotes: Seated leg extension machine, shin pad on lower left shin, right leg relaxed to the side. Extend the left leg to full lockout, squeeze the quad, control the lower. Lighter load — exposes and corrects left-side imbalances.

name_fr: Leg extension à une jambe — Jambe gauche

name: Leg Extension — Single-Leg — Right Leg

name: Leg Swings — Front to Back
setupNotes: Stand side-on to a wall with the near hand on it for balance. Swing the outside leg forward and back like a controlled pendulum, gradually increasing the range. Keep the torso still — the movement comes from the hip, not the lower back. Warms up hip flexors and hamstrings on each side.

name: Lu Raise
setupNotes: Standing with light dumbbells. Front raise to shoulder height, then continue into lateral raise position without lowering. Smooth arc motion.

name: Lying Leg Raise — Alternating
setupNotes: Same position as standard. Lift one leg at a time, alternating. Easier progression. Keep lower back pressed into floor.

name: Lying Leg Raise — Standard
setupNotes: Lie face up, hands under lower back or at sides. Legs straight, lift from floor to vertical. Lower controlled without arching back.

name: Lying Leg Raise with Hold
setupNotes: Raise both legs to ~6 inches off floor. Hold for prescribed time. Lower back pressed into floor. Isometric lower ab hold.
name_es: Elevación de piernas con isometría — Tumbado
name_fr: Relevé de jambes avec maintien — Allongé

name: Lying (Prone) Leg Curl
setupNotes: Lying face down on leg curl machine. Pad on lower calves/ankles. Curl heels toward glutes, squeeze hamstrings at top, controlled lower.
name_fr: Leg curl — Allongé sur le ventre

name: Machine-Assisted Pull-Up
setupNotes: Assisted pull-up / dip machine. Kneel or stand on pad, select counterweight. Grip bar overhead, pull chin above bar.

name: Machine Hip Thrust
setupNotes: Dedicated hip thrust / glute drive machine. Sit in machine, back against pad, feet on platform. Drive hips forward to full extension. Squeeze glutes.

name: Machine Shoulder Press — Neutral Grip
setupNotes: Adjust seat so handles start at ear level. Back against pad, feet flat. Press to full extension. Use neutral grip position.
name_es: Press de hombros — Máquina — Agarre neutro

name: Machine Shoulder Press — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Adjust seat so handles start at ear level. Back against pad, feet flat. Press to full extension. Use overhand grip position.
name_es: Press de hombros — Máquina — Agarre prono

name: Machine Shoulder Press — Underhand Grip
setupNotes: Adjust seat so handles start at ear level. Back against pad, feet flat. Press to full extension. Use underhand grip position.
name_es: Press de hombros — Máquina — Agarre supino

name: March in Place — Standard
setupNotes: Standing, alternate lifting knees to hip height. Pump arms naturally opposite to legs. Controlled pace for warm-up or light cardio.

name: Meadows Row
setupNotes: Barbell loaded in a landmine attachment. Stand perpendicular to the bar in a staggered stance and take an overhand grip on the end of the sleeve with the working hand — row it to the hip with a slight torso rotation, then lower under control. Keep the back flat and drive the elbow back to load the lats and upper back.

name: Meadows Row — Left Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment. Stand perpendicular to the bar in a staggered stance with right foot forward. Overhand grip on the end of the bar with the left hand — row to left hip with slight torso rotation. Targets the lats and upper back.

name: Meadows Row — Right Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment. Stand perpendicular to the bar in a staggered stance with left foot forward. Overhand grip on the end of the bar with the right hand — row to right hip with slight torso rotation. Targets the lats and upper back.

name: Medicine Ball Slam
setupNotes: Standing, medicine ball (slam ball) overhead. Slam ball into floor with maximum force using whole body. Pick up and repeat. Use dead bounce slam ball.

name: Mountain Climber — Cross-Body
setupNotes: High plank position. Drive knee toward opposite elbow. Alternate sides. Rotational element adds oblique engagement to standard climber.

name: Mountain Climber — Standard
setupNotes: High plank position. Drive one knee toward chest quickly, switch, repeat. Fast alternating like running in place horizontally.

name: Mountain Climbers — Fast
setupNotes: High plank position. Sprint knees toward chest alternately as fast as possible. Maintain plank integrity. HIIT cardio from plank.

name: Neck Side Stretch
setupNotes: Stand or sit tall with the shoulders down. Tilt one ear toward the shoulder on the same side, keeping the opposite shoulder relaxed and pressed away, and hold. Add light pressure with the same-side hand if you want more, never a hard pull — stretches the side of the neck and upper trap. Switch sides.

name: Neck Side Stretch — Left
setupNotes: Standing or seated tall, gently tilt the right ear toward the right shoulder, keeping the left shoulder relaxed and pressed down. Optionally use the right hand for light additional pressure. Hold. Stretches the left side of the neck.

name: Neck Side Stretch — Right
setupNotes: Standing or seated tall, gently tilt the left ear toward the left shoulder, keeping the right shoulder relaxed and pressed down. Optionally use the left hand for light additional pressure. Hold. Stretches the right side of the neck.

name: Negative (Eccentric) Pull-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar. Jump or step to top position (chin over bar). Lower body as slowly as possible (5-10 seconds). Repeat.

name: Negative-Only Push-Up
setupNotes: Standard push-up position. Lower body as slowly as possible (5-8 seconds) to floor. Reset to top position and repeat. Eccentric strength.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
setupNotes: Kneeling on mat, ankles anchored (partner holds, GHD pad, or loaded barbell). Lower body forward under control, catch yourself and push back up. Eccentric hamstring.

name: Oblique Cable Crunch
setupNotes: High cable pulley, D-handle or rope. Stand sideways to machine. Crunch laterally, pulling toward hip on cable side. Side-bend motion.

name: Oblique Cable Crunch — Left
setupNotes: High cable pulley, rope or D-handle. Kneel facing the machine, rope behind the head. Crunch the torso down and rotate toward the left hip, bringing the right elbow toward the left knee. Controlled return — emphasises the right obliques.

name: Oblique Cable Crunch — Right
setupNotes: High cable pulley, rope or D-handle. Kneel facing the machine, rope behind the head. Crunch the torso down and rotate toward the right hip, bringing the left elbow toward the right knee. Controlled return — emphasises the left obliques.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row — Standard
setupNotes: Right hand and right knee on flat bench, one side foot on floor, flat back. Dumbbell in one side hand with neutral grip, hanging below shoulder — row to one side hip, elbow close to body. Squeeze the lat at the top.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row — Left Arm
setupNotes: Right hand and right knee on flat bench, left foot on floor, flat back. Dumbbell with neutral grip in left hand hanging below shoulder — row to left hip, elbow close to body. Squeeze the lat at the top.
name_es: Remo a un brazo — Mancuerna — Brazo izquierdo

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row — Right Arm

name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
setupNotes: Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow so the hand drops behind the head. Use the opposite hand to press that elbow gently back and down. Keep the ribs down and avoid arching the lower back. Hold, then switch sides — stretches the triceps and lat.

name_fr: Étirement des triceps au-dessus de la tête

name: Pallof Press — Half-Kneeling with Rotation — Right Arm
setupNotes: Cable at chest height. Half-kneel with the left knee down (closest to the stack), right foot forward, both hands on the handle at the chest. Press the handle out to full extension, then slowly rotate the torso away from the stack to the right and return. Combines anti-rotation with controlled rotation in a low-base position.
name_de: Pallof Press — Halbkniend — Mit Rotation — Rechter Arm
