name: Pallof Press — Standard
setupNotes: Cable at chest height with a D-handle. Stand with the right side toward the stack, hold the handle with both hands at the chest. Press the arms straight forward and resist the cable pulling you into rotation toward the right. Return to chest. Anti-rotation core work.

name: Pallof Press — Standard — Left Arm
setupNotes: Cable at chest height with a D-handle. Stand with the right side toward the stack, hold the handle with both hands at the chest. Press the arms straight forward and resist the cable pulling you into rotation toward the right. Return to chest. Anti-rotation core work.

name: Pallof Press — Standard — Right Arm
setupNotes: Cable at chest height with a D-handle. Stand with the left side toward the stack, hold the handle with both hands at the chest. Press the arms straight forward and resist the cable pulling you into rotation toward the left. Return to chest. Anti-rotation core work.

name: Pallof Press — With Rotation
setupNotes: Cable at chest height. Stand with the right side toward the stack, press the handle out from the chest. From the pressed position slowly rotate the torso away from the stack to the left, then return under control. Combines anti-rotation with controlled rotation.

name: Pallof Press — With Rotation — Left Arm
setupNotes: Cable at chest height. Stand with the right side toward the stack, press the handle out from the chest. From the pressed position slowly rotate the torso away from the stack to the left, then return under control. Combines anti-rotation with controlled rotation.
name_de: Pallof Press — Mit Rotation — Linker Arm

name: Pallof Press — With Rotation — Right Arm
setupNotes: Cable at chest height. Stand with the left side toward the stack, press the handle out from the chest. From the pressed position slowly rotate the torso away from the stack to the right, then return under control. Combines anti-rotation with controlled rotation.

name_es: Press Pallof — Con rotación — Brazo derecho

name: Parallel Bar Dip — Triceps Focus
setupNotes: Parallel dip bars. Upright torso (not leaning forward), elbows close to body and pointing back. Lower until elbows at 90 degrees, press up.
name_es: Fondos en paralelas — Enfoque en tríceps
name_pt: Mergulho nas paralelas — Ênfase no tríceps

name: Pec Deck Machine
setupNotes: Adjust seat height so arms are at chest level. Pads or handles at shoulder width. Back firmly against pad, slight elbow bend.

name: Pelvic-Balloon Breathing
setupNotes: Lie face up, knees bent. Visualise pelvic floor as balloon inflating on inhale (relaxes down) and deflating on exhale (draws up). Coordinate breath.

name: Pelvic Tilts
setupNotes: Lie face up, knees bent, feet flat. Gently tilt pelvis — flatten lower back against floor (posterior tilt), then release to neutral. Gentle rocking motion.

name: Pendlay Row
setupNotes: Barbell on floor. Hinge at hips until torso is parallel to floor. Explosive row from dead stop on each rep. Bar returns to floor between reps.

name: Pendulum Squat
setupNotes: Pendulum squat machine. Shoulders under pads, feet on platform. Machine pivots on arc. Squat deep with constant tension. Very quad-dominant.

name: Pigeon Stretch
setupNotes: From hands and knees, slide one knee forward behind the same-side wrist with the shin angled across the body, then extend the trailing leg back. Lower the torso over the front shin, hold and breathe. Keep the hips square to the floor. Deep stretch of the external rotators and glute — switch sides.

name: Pigeon Stretch — Left
setupNotes: From hands and knees, slide the left knee forward behind the left wrist with the shin angled across the body. Extend the right leg straight back. Lower the torso over the left shin. Hold and breathe. Deep stretch of the left external rotators and glute.

name: Pigeon Stretch — Right
setupNotes: From hands and knees, slide the right knee forward behind the right wrist with the shin angled across the body. Extend the left leg straight back. Lower the torso over the right shin. Hold and breathe. Deep stretch of the right external rotators and glute.

name: Pike Push-Up
setupNotes: Hands on floor, hips piked high (inverted V shape). Feet can be on floor or elevated on bench for extra difficulty. Lower head toward floor, press up. Shoulder emphasis.

name: Plank Hip Dips
setupNotes: Forearm plank position. Rotate hips to lower one side toward floor, then other side. Alternating. Controlled rotation, oblique emphasis.

name: Plank Jacks
setupNotes: High or forearm plank position. Jump feet apart and together (like horizontal jumping jacks). Maintain rigid core. Cardio + core.

name: Plank Shoulder Taps
setupNotes: High plank position, feet slightly wider than hip-width. Tap right hand to left shoulder, left hand to right shoulder. Minimise hip sway.

name: Plank to Push-Up
setupNotes: Start in forearm plank. Push up to high plank one arm at a time, then lower back to forearms. Alternate lead arm each rep.

name: Plank Up-Down — Standard
setupNotes: Start in forearm plank. Push up to high plank one arm at a time, then lower back to forearms. Alternate lead arm each rep.

name: Plate Pinch Hold
setupNotes: Standing, pinch two smooth weight plates together with fingers on one side and thumb on other. Hold for time. Builds pinch grip strength.

name: Power Clean
setupNotes: Barbell on floor, grip just outside knees. First pull to knees, explosive second pull (hips), catch bar on front delts in front rack. Reset to floor.

name: Prisoner Squat
setupNotes: Standing, hands behind head, elbows wide. Perform bodyweight squat. Hands behind head forces upright torso and challenges mobility.

name: Push Press
setupNotes: Bar in front rack on shoulders. Dip knees slightly, drive explosively through legs to press bar overhead to lockout. More weight than strict press.

name: Push-Up (Standard)
setupNotes: Hands shoulder-width on floor, body in straight line from head to heels. Full range — chest to floor, arms fully extended at top.

name: Push-Up to Renegade Row
setupNotes: Push-up position with hands on hex dumbbells. Perform push-up, then row one dumbbell to hip, alternate. Wide foot stance for stability.

name: Rack Pull — Above Knee
setupNotes: Barbell on power rack pins set above knee height. Conventional deadlift grip. Stand up to lockout, squeeze traps and upper back at top.
name_es: Rack pull — Por encima de la rodilla

name: Rear Delt Fly — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Bent over at hips ~45 degrees, dumbbells hanging below chest. Raise arms out to sides, leading with elbows. Light weight, controlled.

name: Rear Delt Fly — Dumbbell — Strong
setupNotes: Bent over at hips ~45 degrees, slight knee bend, flat back, dumbbells hanging below chest with neutral grip. Raise arms wide leading with the elbows until upper arms are parallel to floor — heavier load than standard rear delt fly, slight body english allowed. Controlled lower, squeeze the rear delts and mid-traps.

name: Rear Delt Fly — Machine
setupNotes: Sit facing pad on pec deck / rear delt machine. Grip handles with arms extended. Pull handles back in arc, squeezing rear delts.

name: Renegade Row
setupNotes: Push-up position with hands on dumbbells (hex dumbbells preferred). Row one dumbbell to hip while stabilising on the other. Alternate sides.

name: Resistance Band Scapular Retraction
setupNotes: Anchor band at chest height. Hold with straight arms. Pull shoulder blades together without bending elbows. Release controlled.

name: Reverse Barbell Curl
setupNotes: Standing, overhand (pronated) grip on barbell at shoulder-width. Curl up keeping palms down. Targets brachioradialis and forearm extensors.

name: Reverse Barbell Curl — EZ Bar
setupNotes: Standing, EZ-curl bar held with overhand (pronated) grip at shoulder-width. Elbows tucked at sides. Curl up keeping wrists straight, forearms doing the work. Slight knuckles-up cant of the EZ bar is gentler on wrists than a straight bar — emphasises brachialis and forearm extensors.

name: Reverse Cable Curl
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, straight bar. Overhand (pronated) grip. Curl up keeping palms down. Cable provides constant tension on forearm extensors.

name: Reverse Cable Curl — Narrow Closed Grip
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, straight bar. Overhand (pronated) closed grip, hands narrower than shoulder-width. Curl the bar up keeping palms down and elbows pinned to ribs. Narrow pronated grip biases the brachioradialis and forearm extensors.

name: Reverse Clamshell
setupNotes: Lie on one side with the knees bent and stacked, hips stacked over each other. Keep the knees pressed together and lift the top foot upward, rotating from the hip, then lower under control — the pelvis stays still throughout. Trains internal rotation of the hip, each side.

name: Reverse Clamshell — Left
setupNotes: Lie on the right side, knees bent and stacked. Keep the knees pressed together and lift the left (top) foot upward, rotating from the left hip. Lower under control. Trains internal rotation of the left hip.

name: Reverse Clamshell — Right
setupNotes: Lie on the left side, knees bent and stacked. Keep the knees pressed together and lift the right (top) foot upward, rotating from the right hip. Lower under control. Trains internal rotation of the right hip.

name: Reverse Crunch
setupNotes: Lie on back, hands at sides for support. Bring knees toward chest by curling hips off the floor — lift the lower spine, not just legs. Controlled lower. Targets the lower abs.

name: Reverse Hyper
setupNotes: Reverse hyper machine. Lie face down, hips at edge of pad, grip handles. Extend legs behind and upward using glutes/hamstrings. Controlled swing.

name: Reverse Lunge — Barbell
setupNotes: Barbell racked on the upper back, feet hip-width, chest tall. Step one foot back into a long lunge until both knees reach ~90 degrees and the rear knee hovers just above the floor. Drive through the front heel to return to standing, keeping the torso vertical. Loads the front quad and glute under bar — alternate sides.

name: Reverse Lunge — Barbell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall with a barbell on the upper back, feet hip-width. Step the left foot back into a long lunge, lowering until both knees reach ~90 degrees and the left back knee hovers above the floor. Drive through the right front heel to return to standing. Loads the right front quad and glute under barbell load.
name_es: Zancada hacia atrás — Barra — Pierna izquierda

name: Reverse Lunge — Barbell — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall with a barbell on the upper back, feet hip-width. Step the right foot back into a long lunge, lowering until both knees reach ~90 degrees and the right back knee hovers above the floor. Drive through the left front heel to return to standing. Loads the left front quad and glute under barbell load.
name_es: Zancada hacia atrás — Barra — Pierna derecha

name: Reverse Lunge — Bodyweight
setupNotes: Stand tall, hands on hips. Step one foot back into a long lunge, lowering until both knees reach about 90 degrees and the rear knee hovers just above the floor. Drive through the front heel to return to standing. Keep the torso vertical throughout. Loads the front quad and glute — alternate sides.

name: Reverse Lunge — Bodyweight — Left
setupNotes: Standing tall, hands on hips. Step the left foot back into a long lunge, lowering until both knees reach ~90 degrees and the left back knee hovers above the floor. Drive through the right front heel to return to standing. Loads the right front quad and glute.
name_es: Zancada hacia atrás — Peso corporal — Izquierda
name_fr: Fente arrière — Poids du corps — Gauche

name: Reverse Lunge — Bodyweight — Right
setupNotes: Standing tall, hands on hips. Step the right foot back into a long lunge, lowering until both knees reach ~90 degrees and the right back knee hovers above the floor. Drive through the left front heel to return to standing. Loads the left front quad and glute.
name_es: Zancada hacia atrás — Peso corporal — Derecha
name_fr: Fente arrière — Poids du corps — Droite

name: Reverse Lunge — Dumbbell/Barbell
setupNotes: Standing with dumbbells at sides or barbell on back. Step backward into lunge, lower until front thigh is parallel. Return to start.
name_es: Zancada hacia atrás — Mancuerna o barra

name: Reverse Lunge — Dumbbell/Barbell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall with dumbbells at sides or barbell on back, feet hip-width. Step the left foot back into a long lunge until both knees reach ~90 degrees, left back knee hovering above the floor. Drive through the right front heel to return to standing. Loads the right front quad and glute.
name_es: Zancada hacia atrás — Mancuerna o barra — Pierna izquierda
name_fr: Fente arrière — Haltère ou barre — Jambe gauche
name_pt: Recuo — Halter ou barra — Perna esquerda

name: Reverse Lunge — Dumbbell/Barbell — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing tall with dumbbells at sides or barbell on back, feet hip-width. Step the right foot back into a long lunge until both knees reach ~90 degrees, right back knee hovering above the floor. Drive through the left front heel to return to standing. Loads the left front quad and glute.
name_es: Zancada hacia atrás — Mancuerna o barra — Pierna derecha

name_pt: Recuo — Halter ou barra — Perna direita

name: Reverse Nordic Curl
setupNotes: Kneeling upright on mat (padding under knees). Lean backward slowly keeping hips extended. Feel quad stretch, return to upright. Quad eccentric.

name: Reverse Plank
setupNotes: Sit on floor, hands behind hips, fingers forward. Lift hips until body is straight from shoulders to heels. Squeeze glutes, hold. Triceps and core.

name: Reverse Plank Push-Up (Dip-Style)
setupNotes: Reverse plank position. Bend elbows to lower body, press back up. Like a bench dip but from floor with legs extended straight.
name_es: Flexión en plancha invertida — Estilo fondos
name_pt: Flexão em prancha invertida — Estilo mergulho

name: Reverse Plank with Leg Lifts
setupNotes: Standard reverse plank position. Alternate lifting one leg at a time, keeping it straight. Adds glute and core demand to hold.
name_es: Plancha invertida con elevación de piernas
name_fr: Planche inversée avec levées de jambes
name_pt: Prancha invertida com elevação de pernas

name: Reverse Snow Angels — Standard
setupNotes: Lie prone on mat, arms extended overhead. Sweep arms in arc from overhead to hips and back, keeping arms off the ground throughout.

name: Reverse Snow Angels — Weighted
setupNotes: Same prone position. Hold very light dumbbells (1-2 kg) in each hand. Slow arc from overhead to hips and back.
name_es: Ángeles de nieve inversos — Con peso
name_pt: Anjos da neve invertidos — Com peso

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
setupNotes: Seated, forearms on thighs or preacher bench, palms down. Barbell in hands. Extend wrists upward, controlled lower. Light weight, high reps.

name: Romanian Deadlift — Barbell
setupNotes: Standing, barbell at hip level. Slight knee bend, hinge at hips pushing them back, lower bar along thighs to mid-shin. Flat back, squeeze glutes to return.

name: Romanian Deadlift — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbell in each hand at front of thighs. Same hip hinge as barbell version. Allows more natural arm path.

name: Romanian Deadlift — Trap Bar
setupNotes: Standing inside trap bar. Slight knee bend, hinge at hips, lower bar along sides. Neutral grip is easier on lower back.
name_fr: Soulevé de terre roumain — Trap bar

name: Rotational Push-Up
setupNotes: High plank position, body in a line from head to heels. Perform a push-up, then at the top rotate open into a side plank — top arm reaching to the ceiling, weight on the supporting hand. Stack the shoulders and keep the hips lifted. Return to plank and alternate sides — builds rotational core and shoulder stability.

name: Rotational Push-Up — Left
setupNotes: High plank position, body in a straight line. Perform a push-up, then at the top rotate the body open to the left into a side plank — left arm extended toward the ceiling, weight on the right hand. Return to plank and reset. Builds rotational core and shoulder stability.

name: Rotational Push-Up — Right
setupNotes: High plank position, body in a straight line. Perform a push-up, then at the top rotate the body open to the right into a side plank — right arm extended toward the ceiling, weight on the left hand. Return to plank and reset. Builds rotational core and shoulder stability.

name: Rower — Sprint Intervals
setupNotes: Rowing machine. Alternate between max-effort sprints (20-30 seconds) and easy recovery rowing (60-90 seconds). Damper setting at 4-6.
name_es: Máquina de remo — Intervalos de sprint

name: Rower — Steady
setupNotes: Rowing machine. Strap feet in, grip handle. Drive with legs first, then lean back, then pull arms. Reverse sequence on return. Steady pace.

name: Russian Twist — Bodyweight
setupNotes: Sit on floor, lean back ~45 degrees, feet off ground or anchored. Clasp hands, rotate torso side to side. V-sit position.

name: Russian Twist — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Same seated V-sit position. Hold one dumbbell with both hands at chest. Rotate side to side. Controlled tempo.

name: Russian Twist — Medicine Ball
setupNotes: Same seated position as bodyweight. Hold medicine ball in both hands. Rotate side to side, touching ball on floor beside hips.

name: Scapular Pull-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar, overhand grip. From dead hang, retract and depress scapulae to raise body slightly without bending elbows. Lat activation.

name: Scapular Push-Up
setupNotes: High plank position, arms straight. Without bending elbows, push shoulder blades apart (protract) then squeeze together (retract). Scapular mobility.

name: Scapular Squeeze — Standing
setupNotes: Standing, arms at sides or slightly raised. Squeeze shoulder blades together and down. Hold 5 seconds, release. Posture and upper back activation.

name: Seated Barbell Overhead Press
setupNotes: Seated, barbell in front rack position at collarbone. Feet hip-width. Press straight overhead, lock out, bar over mid-foot.

name: Seated Box Jump
setupNotes: Sit on a bench or low box facing a plyo box, feet flat and torso upright. From a dead stop, drive through the feet and jump onto the box, landing softly in a quarter squat. Step down and reset. Develops starting-strength power.

name: Seated Cable Row — Neutral Grip — Single-Arm
setupNotes: Seated cable row station with a single D-handle, feet on the plate and knees slightly bent. Pull the handle to the ribs with a neutral grip, allowing a slight torso rotation toward the working side — full stretch at the front, shoulder blade squeezed at the back. Targets the lat and mid-back one side at a time.

setupNotes: Seated cable row station, D-handle. Feet on the foot plate, knees slightly bent, free hand braced on the thigh. setupNotes: Seated cable row station, wide lat bar or straight bar. Overhand grip. Pull to lower chest, elbows out to sides.

name: Seated Calf Raise — Machine
setupNotes: Seated calf raise machine. Knee pad on lower thighs, balls of feet on platform. Rise onto toes, squeeze at top, controlled lower. Targets soleus.

name: Seated Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
setupNotes: Seated, hold one heavy dumbbell with both hands behind head, elbows pointing up. Extend arms overhead to lockout.

name_fr: Extension triceps au-dessus de la tête — Haltère — Assis

setupNotes: Seated on bench with back support, feet flat. Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing each other (neutral). Press overhead to full lockout — lower with control.

setupNotes: Seated on bench with back support, feet flat. Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward (overhand). Press overhead to full lockout — lower with control.

setupNotes: Seated on bench with back support, feet flat. Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing you (underhand). Press overhead to full lockout — lower with control.

setupNotes: Sit on floor, legs extended straight. Hinge forward at hips reaching toward feet. Hold. Stretches hamstrings and lower back.

name_pt: Flexão de tronco à frente — Sentado

name: Seated Leg Curl
setupNotes: Seated leg curl machine. Adjust back pad and shin pad. Curl heels toward glutes, controlled return to start. Full range of motion.

name: Seated Smith Machine Calf Raise
setupNotes: Smith machine, bar on upper traps. Balls of feet on edge of platform/plates. Seated variation. Rise and lower with full range.

name: Shoulder Rolls
setupNotes: Standing, roll shoulders forward in circles, then backward. Big controlled circles. Loosens upper traps and shoulder joints.

name: Shoulder Taps with Leg Lift
setupNotes: High plank. Simultaneously lift one hand to opposite shoulder and opposite foot off ground. Double anti-rotation demand.
name_es: Toques de hombro con elevación de pierna
name_fr: Touchers d'épaules avec levée de jambe
name_pt: Toques no ombro com elevação de perna

name: Shrimp Squat
setupNotes: Stand on one leg and hold the other foot behind you at the glute with the same-side hand. Squat down on the standing leg until the trailing knee taps the floor, then drive back to standing. Keep the chest lifted and the standing knee tracking over the toes. Advanced unilateral squat — heavy quad and glute load.

name: Shrimp Squat — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing on the left leg, hold the right foot behind you at the glute with the right hand. Squat down on the left leg until the right knee taps the floor, then drive back to standing. Advanced unilateral squat — heavy left quad and glute load.

name: Shrimp Squat — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing on the right leg, hold the left foot behind you at the glute with the left hand. Squat down on the right leg until the left knee taps the floor, then drive back to standing. Advanced unilateral squat — heavy right quad and glute load.

name: Side Plank
setupNotes: Lie on one side, forearm on the floor directly under the shoulder, feet stacked or staggered. Lift the hips so the body forms a line from head to heels, top arm reaching to the ceiling or resting on the hip. Hold without letting the hips sag. Loads the obliques and QL on the down side — hold each side.

name: Side Plank — Left Side
setupNotes: Lie on the left side, left forearm on the floor under the shoulder, feet stacked or staggered. Lift the hips so the body forms a straight line from head to heels, right arm extended toward the ceiling or on the hip. Hold for time. Loads the left obliques and QL.

name: Side Plank — Right Side
setupNotes: Lie on the right side, right forearm on the floor under the shoulder, feet stacked or staggered. Lift the hips so the body forms a straight line from head to heels, left arm extended toward the ceiling or on the hip. Hold for time. Loads the right obliques and QL.

name: Side Plank with Hip Dips
setupNotes: Side plank on the forearm, elbow under the shoulder and hips lifted in a straight line. Lower the hips slowly toward the floor without touching down, then drive back up to the start — shoulders and hips stay stacked, no rolling forward. Dynamic loading for the obliques, each side.
name_es: Plancha lateral con caídas de cadera
name_fr: Planche latérale avec descentes de hanches
name_pt: Prancha lateral com descida de quadril

name: Side Plank with Hip Dips — Left Side
setupNotes: Side plank on the left forearm, hips lifted in a straight line. Slowly lower the left hip toward the floor without touching, then drive back up to the start. Controlled reps through full range. Dynamic loading of the left obliques.
name_de: Side Plank mit Hüftsenken — Linke Seite

name: Side Plank with Hip Dips — Right Side
setupNotes: Side plank on the right forearm, hips lifted in a straight line. Slowly lower the right hip toward the floor without touching, then drive back up to the start. Controlled reps through full range. Dynamic loading of the right obliques.

name: Side Plank with Leg Lift
setupNotes: Side plank on one forearm, elbow under the shoulder, hips lifted into a straight line from head to heels. Raise the top leg and hold it there, or pulse gently, keeping the hips stacked and square. Don't let the bottom hip sag — obliques hold while the glute medius and outer hip work. Hold for time, then switch sides.

name: Side Plank with Leg Lift — Left Side

Loads the glutes heavily on a per-leg basis.

name: Sissy Squat
setupNotes: Standing, hold something for balance. Lean back, push knees forward over toes, lower body. Extreme quad stretch. Can use sissy squat bench.

name: Sit-to-Stand
setupNotes: Sit on sturdy chair or bench. Stand up without using hands. Sit back down controlled. Functional leg strength for all levels.

name: Ski Erg
setupNotes: Ski erg machine. Stand, grip handles overhead. Pull down using lats and core, hinge slightly at hips. Return arms overhead. Steady or interval pace.

name: Skipping Rope
setupNotes: Jump rope on firm flat surface. Light bounce on balls of feet, wrists control rope rotation. Various speeds and footwork patterns.

name: Sled Pull — Backward Walk
setupNotes: Attach strap to sled, harness around waist. Walk backward pulling sled. Upright torso. Quad and glute emphasis.
name_es: Arrastre de trineo — Caminata hacia atrás

name: Sled Pull — Hand-Over-Hand
setupNotes: Attach long rope to sled. Sit or stand at end of rope. Pull sled toward you hand over hand. Upper back and bicep emphasis.
name_es: Arrastre de trineo — Mano sobre mano
name_fr: Tirage de traîneau — Main après main

name: Sled Push — Heavy (Strength)
setupNotes: Load sled heavy. Low handle grip, lean forward at ~45 degrees. Short powerful steps, drive through toes. Strength and leg power focus.

name: Sled Push — Reverse (Backward)
setupNotes: Face sled, grip handles, walk or drive backward pulling sled toward you with each step. Quad-dominant movement. Knee-friendly.

name: Sled Push — Sprint
setupNotes: Light-moderate load on sled. High handles or low. Sprint for short distance (20-40 metres). Maximum speed effort.

name: Sled Push — Standard
setupNotes: Load sled with moderate weight. Grip high or low handles. Drive forward with legs, steady pace for distance. Lean into sled.

name: Smith Machine Bent-Over Row — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Smith machine, bar at knee height. Hinge at hips, grip bar overhand. Row to lower chest. Guided bar path.
name_fr: Rowing buste penché — Smith machine — Prise pronation

name: Smith Machine Front Squat
setupNotes: Smith machine bar racked across front delts in front-rack or cross-arm position. Feet shoulder-width and slightly forward of the bar path. Squat down keeping torso upright, drive up through heels. Fixed bar path lets you focus purely on squat depth and quad engagement.

name: Smith Machine Shrug
setupNotes: Stand centred in Smith machine, bar at hip level. Overhand grip, shoulder-width. Shrug straight up — machine guides the path.

name: Smith Machine Squat
setupNotes: Smith machine, bar on upper back. Feet slightly forward of bar. Descend to parallel, press up. Machine guides bar path vertically.

name: Spider Curl — Barbell
setupNotes: Prone on incline bench (chest at top). Arms hang straight down, barbell in hands. Curl up with zero momentum. Constant tension.

name: Spider Curl — Barbell EZ Bar
setupNotes: Prone on incline bench (chest at top). Arms hang straight down, EZ-curl bar in hands with semi-pronated grip. Curl bar up toward chin without swinging shoulders. Eliminates body english — pure peak-bicep contraction with friendlier wrist angle than a straight bar.

name: Spider Mountain Climbers
setupNotes: High plank. Bring knee to outside of same-side elbow (wider than standard climber). Alternate. Hip mobility plus core work.

name: Spiderman Plank
setupNotes: High plank position. Bring one knee to same-side elbow, return, alternate. Engages obliques and hip flexors with each rep.

name: Spiderman Push-Up
setupNotes: High plank position, hands under shoulders, body in a line from head to heels. As you lower into the push-up, draw one knee out wide to meet the elbow on the same side, then return it as you press back up. Alternate sides each rep and keep the hips low. Adds oblique and hip-flexor work to the chest press.

name: Spiderman Push-Up — Left
setupNotes: High plank position, hands under shoulders, body in a straight line. As you lower into the push-up, draw the left knee out to meet the left elbow. Return the leg as you press back up. Adds oblique and hip-flexor work to the chest press.

name: Spiderman Push-Up — Right
setupNotes: High plank position, hands under shoulders, body in a straight line. As you lower into the push-up, draw the right knee out to meet the right elbow. Return the leg as you press back up. Adds oblique and hip-flexor work to the chest press.

name: Spin Bike — Standing Climb

name_fr: Vélo de spinning — Montée en danseuse

name: Squat Jacks
setupNotes: Like jumping jacks but lower — jump feet wide into squat, then jump feet together to standing. Arms punch out or overhead at top.

name: Squat-to-Stand
setupNotes: Standing, fold forward touching toes (bend knees if needed). Grab toes, squat hips down, lift chest to deep squat. Stand up. Repeat. Mobility and legs.

name: Stability Ball Jackknife
setupNotes: High plank position with shins on stability ball. Pull knees toward chest rolling ball forward (jackknife). Extend back to plank.

name: Stability Ball Leg Extension Dead Bug

name: Stability Ball Pike
setupNotes: High plank with feet/shins on stability ball. Pike hips upward, pulling ball toward hands. Legs stay straight. Advanced.

name: Stability Ball Plank
setupNotes: Forearms on stability ball, feet on floor. Hold plank position. Ball creates instability, demanding more core stabilisation.

name: Stability Ball Plank — Alternating Leg Lift
setupNotes: Forearms on a stability ball, feet on the floor in plank position. Lift one foot a few inches off the ground, hold briefly, then alternate. Keep hips square and core braced — the unstable elbow base plus single-leg support stacks anti-rotation demand on the trunk.

name: Stability Ball Roll-In (Knee Tuck)

name: Stability Ball Rollout
setupNotes: Kneel behind stability ball, forearms on ball. Roll ball forward extending body, then pull back to start. Similar to ab wheel.

name: Staggered/Offset Push-Up
setupNotes: One hand placed forward, the other back by ~6 inches. Body straight. Push up, switch hand positions between sets.

name: StairMaster — Intervals
setupNotes: StairMaster. Alternate fast and slow stepping, or change levels. Hands off rails for best effect. Short burst high effort, longer recovery.

name: StairMaster — Steady Climb
setupNotes: StairMaster or stepmill. Steady stepping pace, hands light on rails (don't lean on them). Upright posture. Glute and cardio focus.

name: Standard Box Jump
setupNotes: Plyo box at appropriate height. Stand facing box, quarter squat and swing arms, jump onto box landing softly in squat. Step down. Standard start.

name: Standard Hammer Curl — Standing
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbells at sides with neutral (palms-in) grip throughout. Curl up keeping thumbs pointing up. Standard.

name: Standard Lat Pulldown — Machine
setupNotes: Plate-loaded or selectorised lat pulldown machine. Adjust thigh pad. Grip handles, pull to upper chest with controlled form.

name: Standard Pull-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar at height allowing full hang. Overhand grip just outside shoulder-width. Pull chin over bar, full extension at bottom.

name: Standing Ab Wheel Rollout
setupNotes: Standing, grip ab wheel. Roll forward extending body toward floor, pull back using core. Prevent lower back sag.

name: Standing Barbell Overhead Press
setupNotes: Standing, barbell in front rack position at collarbone. Feet hip-width. Press straight overhead, lock out, bar over mid-foot.

name: Standing Bicycle Crunch
setupNotes: Standing, hands behind head. Drive one knee up while rotating opposite elbow to meet it. Alternate sides. Low-impact core work.

name: Standing Cable Crunch
setupNotes: High cable pulley, rope behind head. Standing, feet hip-width. Crunch forward against cable resistance. Core stays engaged throughout.

name: Standing Cable Face Pull
setupNotes: Cable at upper-chest height, rope attachment. Pull toward face, hands ending beside ears. Elbows high, squeeze rear delts. Standing.

name: Standing Calf Raise — Bodyweight
setupNotes: Standing on edge of step or flat floor. Rise up onto toes, squeezing calves at top. Controlled lower. Use wall for balance if needed.

name: Standing Quad Stretch
setupNotes: Stand tall with the free hand on a wall for balance. Pull the working foot up toward the glute with the same-side hand, knees together and hips pressed slightly forward. Hold and breathe, then switch sides — stretches the quad and hip flexor.

name: Standing Quad Stretch — Left

name: Star Jumps
setupNotes: Standing, quarter squat then explode upward spreading arms and legs into X/star shape in air. Land softly in squat. Plyometric full body.

name: Static Lunge Hold
setupNotes: Split stance with one foot forward and the other back, both knees bent to about 90 degrees. Hold the position with the rear knee hovering just above the floor and the torso stacked tall. name: Static Lunge Hold — Left Leg
setupNotes: Split stance with the left foot forward and right foot back, both knees bent to ~90 degrees. Hold the position with the back knee hovering above the floor and torso upright. Isometric quad and glute endurance through the left front leg.

name: Static Lunge Hold — Right Leg
setupNotes: Split stance with the right foot forward and left foot back, both knees bent to ~90 degrees. Hold the position with the back knee hovering above the floor and torso upright. Isometric quad and glute endurance through the right front leg.

name: Stationary Bike — Steady
setupNotes: Adjust seat height so slight bend at bottom of pedal stroke. Steady moderate resistance. Upright or recumbent position. Sustained pace.

name: Step-Up — Barbell
setupNotes: Bench or box at knee height, barbell on upper back. Place one side foot fully on box, drive through one side heel to stand tall on top. Controlled step down. All reps on one side leg.

name: Step-Up — Barbell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Bench or box at knee height, barbell on upper back. Place left foot fully on box, drive through left heel to stand tall on top. Controlled step down. All reps on left leg.

name_pt: Subida no banco — Barra — Perna direita

name: Step-Up — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Sturdy bench or plyo box at knee height, dumbbells at the sides. Step down with control and alternate sides.

name: Step-Up — Dumbbell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Sturdy bench or plyo box at knee height. Dumbbells at sides. Plant the left foot fully on the box and drive through the left heel to stand tall — right foot follows or stays grounded for balance. Step down with control through the left leg. Loads the left quad and glute.

name_es: Subida al cajón — Mancuerna — Pierna derecha
name_pt: Subida no banco — Halter — Perna direita

name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
setupNotes: High cable pulley, straight bar or rope attachment. Stand facing machine, arms extended overhead. Pull bar down to thighs in arc, lats engaged.

name: Suitcase Carry
setupNotes: Hold one heavy dumbbell or kettlebell at the side in a single hand, torso tall and shoulders level. Walk a set distance in a line, resisting the load as it pulls you into a sideways lean. Brace hard through the unloaded side. Anti-lateral-flexion work for the obliques and QL — carry each side.

name: Suitcase Carry — Left
setupNotes: Hold one heavy dumbbell or kettlebell in the left hand at the side. Walk in a straight line keeping the torso tall and shoulders level — resist the load pulling you into a left-side lean. Anti-lateral-flexion through the right obliques and QL.

name: Suitcase Carry — Right
setupNotes: Hold one heavy dumbbell or kettlebell in the right hand at the side. Walk in a straight line keeping the torso tall and shoulders level — resist the load pulling you into a right-side lean. Anti-lateral-flexion through the left obliques and QL.

name: Sumo Barbell Deadlift
setupNotes: Barbell on floor, wide stance with toes pointed out (sumo). Grip bar between knees, arms straight. Flat back, chest up — drive through heels to lockout.

name: Sumo Squat — Barbell
setupNotes: Bar on back, wide stance with toes pointed out ~45 degrees. Descend between legs, knees track over toes. Adductor and glute emphasis.

name: Sumo Squat (Wide-Stance)
setupNotes: Wide stance, toes pointed out 45 degrees. Squat straight down between legs, knees track over toes. Adductor and glute focus.

name: Superman Hold
setupNotes: Lie face down on mat, arms extended overhead. Simultaneously lift arms, chest, and legs off floor. Hold, squeezing glutes and back.

name: Superman Pull (W-Pull)
setupNotes: Lie face down, arms overhead. Lift chest and pull elbows back into W position, squeezing shoulder blades together. Extend arms, repeat.

name: Superman with Physio Ball — Alternating
setupNotes: Lie face down on a mat, physio ball under the hips for support, arms extended overhead. Lift the opposite arm and leg simultaneously (right arm + left leg), hold briefly, then alternate. Ball provides counter-pressure under the hips — squeeze glutes and lower back on each rep.

name: Superman with Physio Ball + Shoulder ROM
setupNotes: Lie prone, hold physio ball in both hands. Lift chest and ball, then move ball through full shoulder range of motion overhead.
name_es: Superman con movilidad de hombro — Fitball
name_fr: Superman avec mobilité d'épaule — Swiss ball
name_pt: Superman com ADM de ombro — Bola suíça

name: Supine Hamstring Stretch with Band
setupNotes: Lie face up with a band or strap looped around the foot of the working leg, the other leg flat on the floor. Extend that leg toward the ceiling with a soft knee and pull gently on the band until you feel a stretch — keep the hips down and the lower back neutral. Hold and breathe, then switch sides.
name_es: Estiramiento de isquiotibiales — Con banda — Tumbado boca arriba
name_fr: Étirement des ischio-jambiers — Élastique — Sur le dos
name_pt: Alongamento de posteriores de coxa — Com elástico — Deitado

name: Supine Hamstring Stretch with Band — Left
setupNotes: Lie face up with a strap or band looped around the left foot. Extend the left leg toward the ceiling, keeping the knee soft, and gently pull the band for a deeper stretch. Right leg stays flat on the floor. Targets the left hamstring.
name_es: Estiramiento de isquiotibiales — Con banda — Tumbado boca arriba — Izquierda

setupNotes: Lie face up with a strap or band looped around the right foot. Extend the right leg toward the ceiling, keeping the knee soft, and gently pull the band for a deeper stretch. Left leg stays flat on the floor. Targets the right hamstring.

name: Supine Heel Slide — Left

name_fr: Glissement du talon — Sur le dos — Gauche

name: Supine Heel Slide — Right
setupNotes: Lie face up, knees bent, feet flat and pelvis in neutral. Slowly slide the right heel along the floor until the leg is straight, then draw it back under control. Maintain a stable pelvis throughout — trains deep core and lumbopelvic control.
name_es: Deslizamiento de talón — Tumbado boca arriba — Derecha
name_fr: Glissement du talon — Sur le dos — Droite

name: Supine Spinal Twist
setupNotes: Lie face up with the arms out in a T. Draw one knee up and across the body toward the floor on the opposite side, keeping both shoulders pressed down. Let gravity carry the knee rather than forcing it. Hold and breathe, then switch sides — gentle rotation for the lumbar spine.
name_es: Torsión de columna — Tumbado boca arriba

name: Supine Spinal Twist — Left
setupNotes: Lie face up, arms out in a T. Pull the left knee up and across the body to the right side, keeping both shoulders pressed to the floor. Let gravity carry the left knee down. Hold and breathe. Gentle rotation of the lumbar spine.
name_es: Torsión de columna — Tumbado boca arriba — Izquierda
name_fr: Torsion vertébrale — Sur le dos — Gauche

name: Supine Spinal Twist — Right
setupNotes: Lie face up, arms out in a T. Pull the right knee up and across the body to the left side, keeping both shoulders pressed to the floor. Let gravity carry the right knee down. Hold and breathe. Gentle rotation of the lumbar spine.
name_es: Torsión de columna — Tumbado boca arriba — Derecha
name_fr: Torsion vertébrale — Sur le dos — Droite

name: Svend Press
setupNotes: Standing, hold two small plates squeezed together at chest height. Press outward while maintaining squeeze. Constant chest contraction.

name: Swiss Ball Hamstring Curl
setupNotes: Lie face up, heels on top of swiss ball, hips lifted. Curl ball toward glutes by bending knees, extend back. Hips stay elevated.

name: Swiss Ball Hip Flexor Stretch — Left
setupNotes: Kneeling lunge with the left shin resting on a swiss ball behind, right foot forward. Tuck the pelvis under and push the hips forward until a stretch is felt at the front of the left hip. Ball cushions the shin and adds slight instability.
name_es: Estiramiento de flexores de cadera — Fitball — Izquierda
name_fr: Étirement du fléchisseur de hanche — Swiss ball — Gauche
name_pt: Alongamento de flexores do quadril — Bola suíça — Esquerda

name: Swiss Ball Hip Flexor Stretch — Right
setupNotes: Kneeling lunge with the right shin resting on a swiss ball behind, left foot forward. Tuck the pelvis under and push the hips forward until a stretch is felt at the front of the right hip. Ball cushions the shin and adds slight instability.
name_es: Estiramiento de flexores de cadera — Fitball — Derecha
name_fr: Étirement du fléchisseur de hanche — Swiss ball — Droite
name_pt: Alongamento de flexores do quadril — Bola suíça — Direita

name: Swiss Ball Side Plank with Leg Lift
setupNotes: one side forearm on floor, feet stacked on swiss ball (one side down). Lift top (the other side) leg while holding a tall side plank. Ball adds instability — brace core hard. Hold for time.
name_es: Plancha lateral con elevación de pierna — Fitball
name_fr: Planche latérale avec levée de jambe — Swiss ball
name_pt: Prancha lateral com elevação de perna — Bola suíça

name: Swiss Ball Side Plank with Leg Lift — Left
setupNotes: Left forearm on floor, feet stacked on swiss ball (left side down). Lift top (right) leg while holding a tall side plank. Ball adds instability — brace core hard. Hold for time.
name_de: Side Plank mit Beinheben — Gymnastikball — Links
name_es: Plancha lateral con elevación de pierna — Fitball — Izquierda
name_fr: Planche latérale avec levée de jambe — Swiss ball — Gauche

name: Swiss Ball Side Plank with Leg Lift — Right
setupNotes: Right forearm on floor, feet stacked on swiss ball (right side down). Lift top (left) leg while holding a tall side plank. Ball adds instability — brace core hard. Hold for time.
name_de: Side Plank mit Beinheben — Gymnastikball — Rechts
name_es: Plancha lateral con elevación de pierna — Fitball — Derecha

name: Swiss Ball V-Pass
setupNotes: Lie face up, swiss ball in hands overhead. Crunch up passing ball from hands to feet, lower. Next rep pass back to hands.

name: Swiss Ball V-Pass Dead Bug
setupNotes: Lie face up, swiss ball held overhead. Pass ball between hands and feet while maintaining dead bug core engagement pattern.
name_pt: Dead bug com V-pass — Bola suíça

name: T-Hold (Lateral Arm Hold)
setupNotes: Standing, arms extended straight to sides at shoulder height. Hold for prescribed time. Shoulder endurance, medial deltoid isometric.

name: Tate Press
setupNotes: Flat bench, dumbbells extended above chest with palms facing feet. Lower dumbbells inward so ends touch on chest, press back up.

name: Tate Press — Single-Arm
setupNotes: Lie on flat bench, single dumbbell extended above chest in each hand, palm facing feet. Bend the elbow inward so the dumbbell tracks toward the right side of the chest — end of dumbbell lightly touches chest. Press back up to lockout. Hits the long head of the triceps with a unique angle.

name: Tate Press — Single-Arm — Left
setupNotes: Lie on flat bench, single dumbbell extended above chest in left hand, palm facing feet. Bend the elbow inward so the dumbbell tracks toward the right side of the chest — end of dumbbell lightly touches chest. Press back up to lockout. Hits the long head of the triceps with a unique angle.
name_es: Press Tate a un brazo — Izquierda
name_fr: Développé Tate à un bras — Gauche

name: Tate Press — Single-Arm — Right
setupNotes: Lie on flat bench, single dumbbell extended above chest in right hand, palm facing feet. Bend the elbow inward so the dumbbell tracks toward the left side of the chest — end of dumbbell lightly touches chest. Press back up to lockout. Hits the long head of the triceps with a unique angle.
name_es: Press Tate a un brazo — Derecha
name_fr: Développé Tate à un bras — Droite

name: Thread the Needle
setupNotes: On hands and knees, reach one arm under the body through the gap between the supporting hand and knee, lowering that shoulder and ear to the floor. Keep the hips stacked over the knees rather than shifting back. Hold and breathe — rotates the thoracic spine, each side.

name: Thread the Needle — Left
setupNotes: On hands and knees, reach the left arm under the body through the space between the right hand and right knee, lowering the left shoulder and ear to the floor. Hold and breathe. Rotates the left thoracic spine.

name: Thread the Needle — Right
setupNotes: On hands and knees, reach the right arm under the body through the space between the left hand and left knee, lowering the right shoulder and ear to the floor. Hold and breathe. Rotates the right thoracic spine.

name: Toes-to-Bar
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar, legs straight. Raise toes all the way to touch the bar. Requires hamstring flexibility and strong core. Controlled lower.

name: Trap Bar Row
setupNotes: Trap bar loaded, hinge at hips. Grip both handles with neutral grip. Row to torso, squeeze upper back. Neutral grip reduces bicep strain.

name: Trap Bar Shrug
setupNotes: Standing inside trap bar loaded with weight. Grip handles, arms straight. Shrug shoulders up toward ears. Neutral grip reduces wrist strain.

name: Treadmill Jog
setupNotes: Treadmill set to jogging pace (7-9 km/h). Easy conversational pace. Land mid-foot, relaxed shoulders and arms.

name: Treadmill Run
setupNotes: Treadmill set to running pace (10-14 km/h). Moderate to hard effort. Good running form — upright posture, mid-foot strike, relaxed hands.

name: Treadmill Sprint
setupNotes: Treadmill set to sprint speed (15+ km/h) or maximum effort for short intervals (15-30 seconds). Hold side rails to mount/dismount safely.

name: Treadmill Walk
setupNotes: Treadmill set to comfortable walking speed (4-6 km/h). Upright posture, arms swinging naturally. Incline optional for added effort.

name: Triceps Pushdown — Reverse Grip
setupNotes: High cable pulley, straight bar with underhand (supinated) grip. Push down to full extension. Emphasises medial head of triceps.
name_es: Extensión de tríceps en polea alta — Agarre invertido
name_fr: Extension triceps — Poulie haute — Prise supination

name: Triceps Pushdown — Rope
setupNotes: High cable pulley, rope attachment. Stand facing machine. Push down and split rope apart at bottom for extra contraction. Elbows stationary.
name_es: Extensión de tríceps en polea alta — Cuerda

name: Triceps Pushdown — Straight Bar
setupNotes: High cable pulley, straight bar attachment. Stand facing machine, elbows pinned to sides. Push bar down to full extension, controlled return.
name_es: Extensión de tríceps en polea alta — Barra recta
name_fr: Extension triceps — Poulie haute — Barre droite

name: Triceps Pushdown — V-Bar
setupNotes: High cable pulley, V-bar attachment. Neutral grip. Push down to full extension. Comfortable on wrists, good triceps isolation.
name_es: Extensión de tríceps en polea alta — Triángulo

name: Tucked Hollow Hold
setupNotes: Lie face up, knees pulled toward chest, shoulders lifted. Arms at sides or extended. Easier regression of full hollow hold.

name: Turkish Get-Up
setupNotes: Lie on the floor holding a kettlebell in one hand pressed straight up, eyes on the bell. Move through the get-up sequence — roll to the elbow, to the hand, hip up, sweep the trail leg through, lunge, stand — keeping the loaded arm vertically locked the entire time. Reverse step-by-step to the floor.

name: Turkish Get-Up — Left
setupNotes: Lie on the floor holding a kettlebell in the left hand pressed straight up, eyes on the bell. Move through the get-up sequence — roll to the right elbow, to the right hand, hip up, sweep the right leg through, lunge, stand — keeping the left arm vertically locked. Reverse to the floor. Full-body unilateral control.

name: Turkish Get-Up — Right
setupNotes: Lie on the floor holding a kettlebell in the right hand pressed straight up, eyes on the bell. Move through the get-up sequence — roll to the left elbow, to the left hand, hip up, sweep the left leg through, lunge, stand — keeping the right arm vertically locked. Reverse to the floor. Full-body unilateral control.

name: Twisting/Supinating Curl
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbells at sides with neutral grip. As you curl up, rotate wrist from neutral to supinated (palms up). Squeeze at top.

name: Twisting/Supinating Curl — Seated
setupNotes: Seated on a bench, dumbbell in each hand with neutral grip. As you curl, rotate the wrists so the palms face up at the top — supinated finish. Controlled lower back to neutral. Targets the biceps with emphasis on the short head.

name: Upper Trap Stretch
setupNotes: Sit tall and place the hand of the working side behind the back to anchor that shoulder down. Tilt the head away from it, adding gentle pressure with the opposite hand on the head — go only to a mild stretch, never force it. Hold and breathe, then switch sides to release the upper traps.

name: Upper Trap Stretch — Left
setupNotes: Seated tall, place the left hand behind the back. Tilt the head away from the left shoulder and use the right hand on the head for gentle additional pressure. Hold. Releases tension in the left upper trap.

name: Upper Trap Stretch — Right
setupNotes: Seated tall, place the right hand behind the back. Tilt the head away from the right shoulder and use the left hand on the head for gentle additional pressure. Hold. Releases tension in the right upper trap.

name: V-Up
setupNotes: Lie face up, arms overhead, legs straight. Simultaneously lift arms and legs to touch hands to feet at top. V shape at peak. Controlled lower.

name: Waiter Curl
setupNotes: Standing, hold one dumbbell vertically with both palms under the top plate. Curl up keeping elbows close. Long head emphasis at peak contraction.

name: Walking Lunge — Barbell
setupNotes: Open floor space, barbell on upper back. Step forward into a deep lunge — front knee tracking over toes. Push off front foot, bring rear foot forward into next lunge.

name: Walking Lunge — Bodyweight
setupNotes: Open floor space (10+ metres). Step forward into lunge, back knee toward floor, push off front foot into next step. Continuous forward motion.

name: Walking Lunge — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Open floor space, dumbbells at sides. Step forward into a deep lunge — front knee tracking over toes. Push off front foot, bring rear foot forward into next lunge.

name: Walking Lunge — Front Rack
setupNotes: Open floor space, barbell in front rack position. Step forward into a deep lunge — front knee tracking over toes. Push off front foot, bring rear foot forward into next lunge.

name: Walking Lunge with Twist
setupNotes: Step into forward lunge, rotate torso toward front leg. Arms extended or hands together. Return to standing, step other leg. Dynamic stretch.

name: Wall Push-Up
setupNotes: Standing arm's-length from wall, hands on wall at shoulder height. Lean in, press back. Beginner regression, control tempo.

name: Wall Sit — Single-Leg
setupNotes: Back flat against a wall, knees bent to about 90 degrees as in a standard wall sit. Extend one leg straight out in front so all the weight sits on the supporting leg, and hold for time. Keep the supporting knee stacked over the ankle — a hard isometric load on the quad. Switch sides.
name_es: Sentadilla isométrica en pared a una pierna
name_fr: Chaise au mur à une jambe

name: Wall Sit — Single-Leg — Left Leg
setupNotes: Back flat against the wall, knees bent to ~90 degrees as in a standard wall sit. Extend the right leg straight forward, all weight on the left leg. Hold for time. Significantly harder — isometric load on the left quad.
name_es: Sentadilla isométrica en pared a una pierna — Pierna izquierda
name_fr: Chaise au mur à une jambe — Jambe gauche
name_pt: Agachamento isométrico na parede unilateral — Perna esquerda

name: Wall Sit — Single-Leg — Right Leg
setupNotes: Back flat against the wall, knees bent to ~90 degrees as in a standard wall sit. Extend the left leg straight forward, all weight on the right leg. Hold for time. Significantly harder — isometric load on the right quad.
name_es: Sentadilla isométrica en pared a una pierna — Pierna derecha
name_fr: Chaise au mur à une jambe — Jambe droite
name_pt: Agachamento isométrico na parede unilateral — Perna direita

name: Wall Sit — Standard
setupNotes: Back flat against wall, slide down until thighs parallel to floor. Knees at 90 degrees, directly over ankles. Hold for prescribed time.

name: Wall Sit — Weighted
setupNotes: Standard wall sit position with dumbbell or weight plate on thighs. Increases quad demand. Maintain flat back against wall.
name_es: Sentadilla isométrica en pared — Con peso
name_pt: Agachamento isométrico na parede — Com peso

name: Wall Thoracic Extension
setupNotes: Stand facing wall, arms overhead on wall. Slowly push chest toward wall, arching upper back. Hold stretch. Thoracic extension mobility.

name: Weighted Arm Circles
setupNotes: Standing, light dumbbells (1-3 kg) in each hand, arms extended. Small controlled circles. Forward and backward. Shoulder endurance.

name: Weighted Dead Hang
setupNotes: Pull-up bar with dip belt and plates or weighted vest. Full hang, grip endurance and spinal decompression under load.

name: Weighted Decline Crunch
setupNotes: Decline bench, hold weight plate or dumbbell on chest. Crunch up against added resistance. Controlled eccentric back down.

name: Weighted Hanging Leg Raise
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar with light dumbbell between feet or ankle weights. Straight-leg raise to horizontal. Controlled eccentric.
name_es: Elevación de piernas — Con peso — Colgado
name_pt: Elevação de pernas — Com peso — Suspenso

name: Weighted Hollow Hold
setupNotes: Full hollow body position with light dumbbell in hands and/or between feet. Hold position for prescribed time. Advanced.

name: Weighted Superman Hold
setupNotes: Same prone position as standard. Hold light dumbbells in hands and/or light ankle weights. Lift and hold. Controlled breathing.

name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar, overhand grip significantly wider than shoulders. Pull chest toward bar. More lat emphasis, less bicep.

name: Wide-Grip Push-Up
setupNotes: Hands placed 6-8 inches wider than shoulders on floor. Body in straight line, core braced. Lower chest to floor, press up.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
setupNotes: From standing, step one foot forward into a deep lunge and place both hands on the floor inside that foot. Rotate the torso toward the front knee and reach the top arm up toward the ceiling, eyes following the hand. Keep the rear leg long and strong. Mobilises hip, T-spine and hamstrings — alternate sides.

name: World's Greatest Stretch — Left
setupNotes: From standing, step the left foot forward into a deep lunge and place both hands on the floor inside the left foot. Rotate the torso toward the left knee and reach the left arm up toward the ceiling. Hold, then return. Mobilises the left hip, T-spine, and hamstring.
name_es: El mejor estiramiento del mundo — Izquierda

name: World's Greatest Stretch — Right
setupNotes: From standing, step the right foot forward into a deep lunge and place both hands on the floor inside the right foot. Rotate the torso toward the right knee and reach the right arm up toward the ceiling. Hold, then return. Mobilises the right hip, T-spine, and hamstring.
name_es: El mejor estiramiento del mundo — Derecha

name: Wrist Rolls
setupNotes: Extend arms forward, circle wrists in both directions. Open and close fists between circles. Warms up wrist joints for pressing and gripping.

name: Y-Raise — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Prone on incline bench (face down) or standing bent over. Raise dumbbells in Y-shape overhead. Light weight, controlled.

name: Zercher Squat
setupNotes: Bar held in crook of elbows at chest height. Feet shoulder-width. Squat down between arms, bar stays in elbow crease. Pad bar with towel.

name: Zottman Curl
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbells at sides. Curl up with supinated grip (palms up), rotate to pronated grip (palms down) at top, lower slowly with pronated grip.
